jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

About the Role -

As a Knowledge Strategist Team Lead, Governance at Instacart, you will lead the Governance group within the Knowledge Strategy team. You will establish and maintain content standards for readability and AI retrieval, own the team's auditing function, and spearhead high-impact internal projects that advance our knowledge infrastructure. You will directly manage 2+ Knowledge Strategists and serve as the team's primary owner of triage, prioritization, and deadline accountability.

This role demands both strategic vision and operational precision. You will be equally comfortable defining a governance framework and rolling up your sleeves to see it through — with deep expertise in how structured knowledge powers contact center AI tools. You are a team leader: mentoring your pod, influencing cross-functional partners, and keeping quality high in a fast-paced environment.

About the Team -

The Instacart Customer Experience Process Improvement & Content Operations (PICO) team harnesses our collective expertise to create world-class customer support experiences that foster loyalty, solve problems efficiently, and support the continuous evolution of our business.

PICO encompasses knowledge strategy, content operations, project management, continuous improvement analytics, and learning and development. Each subteam has a unique and critical role to play in supporting our end users and specialists, and cross-functional collaboration is critical to our success.

The Knowledge Strategy team is vital for maintaining the integrity and accessibility of company information for our Customer Experience support team. We play a direct role in Instacart's success by managing and optimizing how knowledge is shared and utilized across the company, fostering a culture of transparency and informed decision-making. We support product launches, continuous improvement efforts, and regulatory requirements by ensuring we have the right strategy, plans, and metrics in place to provide a high-quality experience for our customers, shoppers, retailers, and CX specialists.

About the Job

In this role, you will focus on elevating the quality, consistency, and AI-readiness of Instacart's CX knowledge base. You will:

  • Own governance and content standards: Define and maintain standards for readability, structure, and AI retrieval compatibility across the knowledge base. Establish guidelines and ensure adherence through regular auditing cycles.
  • Lead auditing and quality assurance: Oversee regular audits of the knowledge base, identify gaps and inconsistencies, and drive remediation. Maintain a culture of accuracy and continuous improvement within the pod.
  • Lead strategic internal projects: Spearhead high-impact projects such as migrating workflows across platforms and optimizing knowledge architecture for AI tools like Sierra and Genesys Copilot.
  • Report knowledge metrics and drive continuous improvement: Track and report on knowledge health metrics. Identify trends, surface insights, and lead continuous improvement initiatives grounded in data.
  • Lead and develop your team: Directly manage a small team of Knowledge Strategists. Provide coaching, mentorship, clear direction, and regular feedback to build a high-performing team. You’ll operate as a player-coach, executing work yourself as needed.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Act as the primary Knowledge representative for governance-related work with Product, Engineering, Legal, TechGov, and CX stakeholders. Influence standards and tooling decisions that affect the broader knowledge ecosystem.
  • Pioneer AI and automation adoption: Lead adoption of AI-driven tools to enhance content quality, retrieval accuracy, and governance efficiency at scale.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience & Context: 4+ years of experience in knowledge strategy within a high-volume customer support organization.
  • Strategic Process Optimization: Proven ability to identify, articulate, and resolve end-to-end operational inefficiencies, driving practical and scalable optimization with limited supervision.
  • Systems & Tools: Robust, hands-on understanding of contact center and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Genesys).
  • Data-Driven Focus: Advanced ability to interpret and leverage CX metrics (e.g., AHT, FCR) and content metrics (readability, deflection rates) to identify and implement improvements.
  • Communication & Advocacy: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical processes into clear, accessible documentation for diverse audiences and advocate effectively for the end-user experience across cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Legal). Ability to present complex scenarios to executive-level audiences.
  • Automation & AI: Experience leveraging AI/automation tools to streamline workflows and generate high-quality content.
  • People Lead: Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop individual contributors.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in a tech or startup environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in using AI tools to automate processes and generate/review content.
  • Experience leading transformational knowledge projects.
  • Intermediate proficiency in SQL to query databases and modify dashboards.
  • Advanced understanding of change management best practices, to identify optimal approaches to communicate and scale changes to a large user base.
  • Deep familiarity with Shopper, Customer, and Retailer contact journeys.
  • Experience with structured content authoring and AI knowledge retrieval optimization (e.g., for chatbot or copilot surfaces).
  • Experience managing knowledge infrastructure migrations across platforms.

We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Sylheti-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Sylheti Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.75 - $0.90 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Sylheti Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Sylhetiand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inSylhetiand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

jobs.description:
About MojoTech

MojoTech is an innovative technology consulting firm that integrates strategy, design, data, and software engineering to create results-driven, AI-enabled digital products and experiences.

We partner with our clients to discover, define, design, and build tomorrow’s innovations, empowering organizations to unlock future market potential, maximize returns on innovation, and drive transformational change.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Architect with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, .NET, and AI-accelerated software development to lead client engagements across architecture, delivery, and growth.

This role combines hands-on technical leadership with client engagement and business development. You will work directly with client stakeholders to modernize applications, shape cloud solutions, guide teams through delivery, and grow accounts through trusted relationships and strong outcomes.

You will also help teams adopt AI-assisted and agentic development practices responsibly. This includes using AI to accelerate software design, implementation, code review, debugging, documentation, and delivery while ensuring that people remain accountable for architectural decisions, quality, security, and production readiness.

You will be expected to stay close to the work. This is a hands-on leadership role in which you will set technical direction, evaluate architecture and code, unblock teams, and step in when needed to move delivery forward.

Key Responsibilities

Azure and .NET Architecture Leadership

  • Design and deliver scalable, maintainable, and secure applications using C#, .NET, Core, and Microsoft Azure
  • Lead the architecture and development of distributed, cloud-native applications, APIs, integration services, and data-driven solutions
  • Modernize legacy .NET and .NET Framework applications using incremental migration, re-platforming, refactoring, or cloud-native modernization approaches
  • Design Azure solutions using services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB
  • Design secure identity and access management solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, managed identities, and role-based access control
  • Apply Azure Well-Architected Framework principles to improve reliability, security, performance, operational excellence, and cost management
  • Establish application integration patterns using REST APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture, and microservices where appropriate
  • Guide teams in the practical use of automated testing, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure as code, and DevOps practices
  • Use Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bicep, Terraform, or similar tools to create repeatable build, deployment, and infrastructure processes
  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs and make clear, pragmatic recommendations based on business needs, delivery constraints, and long-term maintainability
  • Provide hands-on technical support through architecture reviews, code reviews, proof-of-concept development, and complex troubleshooting

AI-Accelerated Engineering Leadership

  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software design, implementation, testing, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving
  • Design and lead agentic development workflows that support parallelized coding, autonomous task execution, and orchestration across complex software initiatives
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to software development, system design, code generation, testing, analysis, and technical documentation
  • Use AI to create and maintain documentation, architecture diagrams, technical specifications, delivery plans, test assets, and other project artifacts
  • Establish clear standards for reviewing, validating, testing, and securing AI-generated code and technical outputs
  • Design workflows in which humans remain accountable for architectural decisions, implementation quality, security, compliance, and production outcomes
  • Use rapid prototyping to validate ideas and technical approaches, followed by structured production hardening across architecture, code quality, security, testing, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help teams determine where AI-assisted or agentic workflows provide meaningful value and where traditional engineering approaches are more appropriate
  • Monitor the effectiveness of AI-enabled engineering practices and continuously improve the team’s tools, workflows, and quality controls
  • Coach clients and delivery teams on the responsible adoption of AI-accelerated software engineering practices

Client Engagement

  • Work directly with client stakeholders to understand business and technical challenges, define solutions, and align on measurable outcomes
  • Lead discovery engagements, application and cloud assessments, modernization planning, and early-stage solution design
  • Assess existing .NET applications and Azure environments to identify technical debt, security risks, operational gaps, and modernization opportunities
  • Evaluate client software delivery practices and identify opportunities to introduce AI-assisted and agentic development workflows
  • Facilitate technical workshops and architecture discussions with engineering teams, business leaders, and executive stakeholders
  • Translate business requirements into clear, executable technical strategies, roadmaps, and delivery plans
  • Communicate complex Azure, .NET, and AI-enabled engineering concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Build strong client relationships that position MojoTech as a trusted technology and delivery partner

Sales and Growth

  • Partner with account and sales leaders to shape and win Azure, .NET, application modernization, and AI-accelerated engineering engagements
  • Contribute to proposals, estimates, staffing plans, technical approaches, and client presentations
  • Support technical discovery and solutioning during the sales process
  • Identify follow-on opportunities within existing client engagements
  • Clearly articulate the business and technical value of proposed solutions
  • Help develop reusable Azure, .NET, cloud modernization, and AI-enabled engineering offerings, reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery approaches

Program and Delivery Leadership

  • Lead technical delivery across one or more engagements, ensuring work remains aligned with agreed goals, timelines, budgets, and quality expectations
  • Establish lightweight governance, planning, architecture decision-making, and communication practices that keep teams moving
  • Coordinate across engineering, product, design, data, cloud infrastructure, and security disciplines
  • Structure work so teams can safely use parallelized and agentic development approaches while maintaining appropriate review and integration controls
  • Identify architectural, technical, and delivery risks early and work with teams and client stakeholders to address them
  • Ensure architecture decisions are translated into working software and consistently implemented across delivery teams
  • Maintain a strong focus on production readiness, measurable outcomes, and sustainable client ownership
  • Ensure rapid prototypes move through a defined production-hardening process before release

Team and Practice Leadership

  • Mentor engineers and architects and help develop technical leadership across project teams
  • Establish high standards for .NET development, Azure architecture, AI-assisted engineering, code quality, system design, security, testing, and production readiness
  • Coach teams on AI-accelerated code review, debugging, implementation, prompt engineering, and agentic development workflows
  • Contribute to hiring, interviewing, and building a strong senior engineering organization
  • Help evolve MojoTech’s Azure, .NET, cloud modernization, and AI-native engineering practices
  • Contribute to technical standards, reference architectures, reusable components, prompt libraries, development workflows, and delivery playbooks
  • Stay current with developments across the Microsoft technology ecosystem and AI-assisted software development
  • Remain hands-on enough to maintain technical credibility and provide meaningful support when teams encounter difficult problems

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience designing, building, and delivering production software systems
  • Deep expertise in C#, .NET, Core, and modern application architecture
  • Significant experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on Microsoft Azure
  • Experience modernizing legacy .NET Framework applications and migrating on-premises systems to Azure
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, REST APIs, microservices, messaging, and event-driven patterns
  • Experience with Azure services such as App Service, Functions, Container Apps, AKS, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, managed identities, and cloud security practices
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bicep, Terraform, or comparable technologies
  • Strong knowledge of relational data modeling, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, and application integration patterns
  • Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate code reviews, debugging, software design, implementation, testing, and technical problem-solving
  • Experience designing or leading agentic development workflows involving parallelized coding, autonomous task execution, and orchestration
  • Strong prompt engineering skills applied to software development, system generation, code analysis, testing, and documentation
  • Experience using AI to generate and maintain technical documentation, architecture artifacts, specifications, and delivery assets
  • Experience establishing human review, validation, security, and quality controls for AI-generated code and technical outputs
  • Experience rapidly prototyping software solutions and leading the structured hardening required to move them into production
  • Experience leading architecture and delivery within consulting or other client-facing environments, particularly at small or mid-sized firms
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with engineers, business leaders, and executive stakeholders
  • Experience contributing to technical sales, proposals, estimates, and solution presentations
  • BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with containers, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Microsoft Azure certifications, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate
  • Experience integrating Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, LLMs, RAG patterns, or other AI-enabled capabilities into production applications
  • Experience establishing AI-assisted software development standards, governance, or reusable delivery practices across multiple teams

Flexible Working Environment

We offer a flexible working model that allows employees to choose between remote work, on-site work at our offices in Boulder, CO, and Providence, RI, or a hybrid arrangement. We also welcome candidates based in Phoenix, AZ as we continue to expand our presence in the area.

This position is remote but requires candidates to reside in one of the following states: RI, CO, AZ, CT, FL, MA, MD, ME, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, SC, TN, or UT. Preference will be given to candidates within commuting distance of our offices in Boulder, CO, or Providence, RI.

Benefits

  • Base salary of $145,000–$190,000
  • Medical and dental insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401(k) with up to a 4% company match
  • Trust-based time off
  • Catered lunches when working in an office
  • Dedicated time for self-directed, non-client work
  • Dog-friendly offices
  • Remote, hybrid, or in-office working options
  • Paid conference attendance and annual education stipend
  • Generous family leave policy

The ideal candidate is a technically strong tax professional with public company experience, a solid understanding of ASC 740 income tax accounting and tax reporting requirements, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to translate complex tax matters into meaningful business insights for senior leadership. This position is eligible for remote work within the United States. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, planning sessions, or other business needs.

The Day-to-Day

Income Tax Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Lead the quarterly and annual income tax provision process in accordance with ASC 740
  • Prepare and review U.S. current and deferred income tax calculations
  • Manage accounting for uncertain tax positions (FIN 48 / ASC 740-10)
  • Perform effective tax rate (ETR) analyses and prepare clear explanations of period-over-period tax rate drivers
  • Prepare and review income tax footnote disclosures for SEC filings, including Forms 10-Q and 10-K
  • Support quarterly earnings processes by providing tax analyses, forecasts, and executive-level reporting materials

U.S. Federal & State Tax Compliance

Tax Audits & Controversy

  • Lead U.S. federal, state, and local income tax audits, examinations, notices, and controversy matters

Tax Planning & Technical Research

  • Support tax planning initiatives designed to optimize the Company's effective tax rate and cash tax position

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

Required

Would you like to be Proforto’s voice in Poland? We’re looking for someone to set up customer service for our Polish market and who will also be available right away to assist our Danish and Swedish customers.

You'll be Proforto's Polish voice from day one, with our Danish and Swedish customers alongside it. There's no script waiting for you and no Polish playbook yet: you'll write it. We started in 2014 on a simple premise: kitting out a workforce shouldn't be a hassle. Today, tens of thousands of companies in construction, industry, healthcare, hospitality and transport buy their gear from us. Around 250,000 products from 140 brands, from work trousers and jackets to safety boots, gloves, helmets and PPE, with logos printed and embroidered in-house. Our office is in Nijmegen, our warehouse in Oosterhout, and between them we ship thousands of orders a week. Customers in the Netherlands who order before 11 PM have it the next morning.

Belgium has been part of our home market for years and Germany went live in early 2026. Poland is next: a large market with plenty of established local suppliers, which means we'll have to earn our place in it.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $30/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

This role is on the Intercept team, which is part of Stripe's broader collection of public goods initiatives, including Frontier.

Respiratory viruses kill 1 million people a year, cost us $600B annually, disrupt everyday life, and periodically threaten civilization. Recent breakthroughs may make it possible to develop and deploy broad-spectrum preventatives and air cleaning technologies that defend against common respiratory infections. Intercept is a $500M philanthropic initiative that aims to radically reduce the burden of respiratory infections, and eventually eliminate them altogether. Learn more about Intercept via our launch post and our website.

What you’ll do

Intercept is looking for an exceptional scientist to join our team. We’re working to bring into existence a portfolio of broad-spectrum preventatives needed to radically reduce the burden of respiratory viruses. Our goal is to advance 2+ products that meet our target product profile through Phase 2. We make both grants and investments, using the most capital-efficient tool to advance our target product profile.

This role will focus on conducting research, managing projects, and supporting diligence across our grant and equity pipelines. This work requires shaping and building out our internal points-of-view across a wide range of modalities that are relevant to respiratory viruses, which include innate immunity, adaptive immunity, direct-acting antivirals, host-directed therapeutics, and physical formulation barriers for the upper respiratory tract. The role will generate high-quality theses to guide our approach to grant and equity investments as well as engage with a wide range of scientific experts, investors, funders, and other key stakeholders in the ecosystem to make sure Intercept is funding the best high-conviction ideas, concepts, and platforms.

We need someone who can (1) evaluate the quality and value of the science for impact vs probability of success, and (2) zoom out to synthesize what that means for our capital deployment plan and long-term goals. A successful candidate will be action-oriented and comfortable working independently (vs. waiting to be told what to do) and a great communicator who can translate complex science for diverse audiences.

Intercept is a small team; you'll work with the entire team, under Intercept’s Head of Science, many partners, and wear many hats. You'll own specific outcomes end-to-end and have a chance to contribute to BSP strategy over time.

Responsibilities

  • Develop theses on technological approaches to inform capital deployment. Generate high-quality research outputs to inform investment theses. Support the development of internal points of view for the most promising approaches that have the potential to meet our TPP. Experience with thinking through high-value experiments, technical data scrutiny, and triaging a wide funnel of ideas into the highest quality theses will be essential.
  • Identify scientific gaps and promising-but-underexplored ideas. Accelerate progress by identifying the questions that would most accelerate progress if answered. Hunt for the promising ideas that aren’t yet being fully explored.
  • Support diligence of grants and investments. Help review and triage inbound submissions received through our published RFP, identifying the most relevant projects and ideas that could result in the optimal broad-spectrum preventative. Help update our RFP material and/or launch specialized calls based on the current state of the field/portfolio.
  • Diligence pipeline opportunities. Support early and deep / technical diligence of our grant and equity pipeline: evaluating science quality, development plans, team, and fit against our TPP.
  • Engage a network of experts and primary literature to keep our strategy current. Engage networks (researchers, investors, founders, funders, etc.) to track research priorities, forecast trends, and identify cutting edge areas of science that Intercept should pursue.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Must have a PhD and/or MD in immunology and/or infectious disease with 3+ years of post-grad work experience (post-doc, academia, biotech, pharma, VC, or consulting)
  • Demonstrated capacity to explore and evaluate a broad range of scientific topics and experience with scientific curation (e.g., oversight of a research portfolio, grant making experience, investment experience, etc.)
  • Experience with the grant process, either success with receiving grant funding or awarding grants
  • Familiar with early-stage product development, ideally with some experience / contribution
  • Experience with project management from launch to completion / project quarterback with a high openness to getting hands dirty
  • Extremely self-directed, diligent, very fast learner, excellent communicator, very action oriented (vs talking about things)
  • Compelled by our mission to greatly reduce the burden of and risks from respiratory viruses

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with capital allocation, either with grants and/or investments
  • Experience with portfolio management, including portfolio construction and post-award management
  • Direct product development experience (optimally with candidate nomination, CMC, IND-enabling studies, and Ph I trial launch)

Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for deployments, incident response, and on-call rotations)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to build, maintain, and optimize cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and system reliability across production environments.

This role requires deep expertise in cloud platforms, automation, CI/CD, container orchestration, monitoring, and infrastructure security. The DevOps Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring systems remain scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available while enabling development teams to ship code efficiently and safely.

The ideal candidate is proactive, automation-driven, calm under pressure, and passionate about improving infrastructure reliability and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Management

  • Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure cloud platforms
    • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation
    • Configure networking, compute, storage, IAM, and cloud security policies
    • Optimize infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost efficiency

CI/CD & Deployment Automation

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI
    • Automate build, testing, deployment, and rollback workflows across environments
    • Ensure zero-downtime deployments and reliable release processes
    • Improve deployment speed, consistency, and operational reliability

Containerization & Kubernetes

  • Manage Docker containers and Kubernetes clusters for microservices deployment
    • Monitor cluster health, resource allocation, and workload performance
    • Optimize orchestration strategies for scalability and reliability
    • Troubleshoot container and deployment-related issues across environments

Monitoring, Logging & Incident Response

  • Implement observability and monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic
    • Configure centralized logging and alerting pipelines using ELK Stack, Splunk, or similar tools
    • Participate in incident response and on-call rotations
    • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive solutions post-incident

Security & Compliance

  • Apply infrastructure security best practices including IAM, encryption, secrets management, and least-privilege access
    • Support compliance requirements such as SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or GDPR where applicable
    • Conduct vulnerability scans, patch management, and security hardening activities
    • Ensure infrastructure remains secure, compliant, and audit-ready

Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Partner closely with development teams to improve deployment workflows and automation
    • Support developers with infrastructure troubleshooting and environment management
    • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency
    • Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational procedures

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong problem solver who thrives at the intersection of development and operations
    • Calm, analytical, and methodical during incidents and high-pressure situations
    • Passionate about automation, infrastructure scalability, and reliability engineering
    • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across technical teams
    • Proactive mindset focused on preventing issues before they impact production

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Engineering
    • Proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
    • Strong experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines
    • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
    • Infrastructure-as-Code expertise with Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation
    • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic
    • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or similar languages
    • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices and infrastructure reliability

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience with microservices and distributed systems
    • Familiarity with serverless technologies (AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions)
    • Experience managing production-grade Kubernetes environments
    • Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA, or equivalent
    • Background supporting SaaS, fintech, healthcare, or enterprise applications

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A DevOps Engineer’s day revolves around keeping systems secure, automated, scalable, and reliable. You will:

  • Review monitoring dashboards and respond to infrastructure alerts or incidents
    • Improve CI/CD pipelines to streamline testing and deployment workflows
    • Provision or optimize infrastructure using Terraform or cloud-native tools
    • Troubleshoot deployment issues and collaborate with developers on production releases
    • Monitor Kubernetes clusters and containerized services for performance and reliability
    • Document workflows, update runbooks, and improve operational processes
    • Analyze logs, metrics, and incidents to proactively prevent future issues

In essence: you are responsible for ensuring infrastructure remains secure, scalable, automated, and capable of supporting fast, reliable product delivery.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

• System uptime ≥ 99.9%

  • Faster and more reliable deployment frequency
    • Reduced MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery) during incidents
    • Infrastructure cost optimization and efficiency improvements
    • Deployment success rate and rollback reduction
    • Positive developer feedback on infrastructure reliability and deployment speed

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote position aligned with U.S. business hours
    • Flexible schedule for deployments and incident response
    • Opportunity to work with modern cloud infrastructure and cutting-edge DevOps tooling
    • Exposure to complex infrastructure and scalability challenges
    • Professional growth in DevOps, SRE, and cloud engineering

• Competitive compensation package

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Technical Assessment (e.g., design a CI/CD pipeline or provision infrastructure with Terraform)
    • Client Interview with Engineering/DevOps Leadership

• Offer & Background Verification

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Operations professional to help build and scale the operational foundation of Tailscale’s Talent Acquisition organization.

You’ll partner closely with TA leadership, Talent Acquisition Partners, Sourcers, Coordinators, and cross-functional teams to build efficient, scalable recruiting processes and deliver an exceptional candidate and hiring team experience. You’ll own and improve core areas including recruiting systems, analytics and reporting, process design, coordinator operations, and operational programs.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving operational problems, creating structure, and using technology and data to make recruiting more effective. You’ll have the opportunity to expand your ownership over time and help shape how Talent Acquisition Operations evolves as Tailscale scales.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition Operations & Systems

  • Administer, configure, and continuously optimize our recruiting technology stack, workflows, permissions, integrations, templates, and operational processes.
  • Partner with TA leadership to identify and implement process and system improvements across the recruiting lifecycle.
  • Support recruiting technology implementations, upgrades, integrations, and vendor relationships.
  • Maintain system integrity, documentation, and standard operating procedures that create consistency and scalability.

Talent Acquisition Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and maintain recruiting dashboards and recurring reporting that provide visibility into hiring progress, pipeline health, funnel performance, recruiting activity, and other key metrics.
  • Analyze recruiting data to identify trends, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable insights for TA and business stakeholders.
  • Partner with TA leadership to define meaningful recruiting metrics and reporting cadences that support team performance and business decision-making.
  • Support headcount tracking, hiring forecasts, and data quality to ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and actionable.

Talent Acquisition Programs & Process Improvement

  • Design and implement scalable recruiting programs, processes, and operational initiatives that improve team effectiveness and candidate experience.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies and translate them into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Create and maintain recruiting playbooks, hiring guides, process documentation, and other resources that drive consistency and adoption.
  • Lead operational projects from planning through implementation in partnership with People, Finance, IT, Legal, and other cross-functional teams.

Talent Acquisition Coordinator Partnership

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition Coordinators to improve scheduling operations, candidate communications, interview logistics, and candidate experience.
  • Serve as an operational resource and escalation point for complex coordination or recruiting process challenges.
  • Document and optimize coordinator workflows, identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and help build scalable operating practices.
  • Partner with TA leadership on coordinator capacity and provide coverage during periods of increased hiring activity or planned time off as needed.

Recruiting Technology, Automation & AI

  • Partner with the Talent Intelligence, Sourcing & AI Programs Lead to operationalize recruiting technologies, AI-enabled workflows, and automation initiatives.
  • Support implementation, documentation, enablement, and adoption of new tools and workflows across Talent Acquisition.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and create more efficient recruiting experiences through technology and automation.
  • Ensure new tools and workflows integrate effectively with existing recruiting processes while maintaining appropriate standards for data quality, privacy, and candidate experience.

Compliance & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain recruiting documentation, operational standards, and processes that support compliance and audit readiness.
  • Partner with appropriate stakeholders to ensure recruiting processes align with internal policies and applicable employment requirements.
  • Identify and address operational risks while continuously improving the consistency, effectiveness, and scalability of recruiting operations.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reports, working with recruiting metrics, and translating data into actionable insights.
  • Strong attention to detail and judgment, with the ability to maintain data integrity while managing multiple priorities and operational initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to work effectively across Talent Acquisition, People, Finance, IT, Legal, and business teams.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity, adopting new technologies, and building scalable solutions as the organization evolves.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting Talent Acquisition Operations within a high-growth or globally distributed technology company.
  • Experience with recruiting technologies such as Greenhouse, ModernLoop, Crosschq, Metaview, LinkedIn Recruiter, or similar platforms.
  • Experience building recruiting dashboards and reporting using Google Sheets, Looker, Tableau, or similar analytics tools.
  • Experience using automation or AI-enabled tools to improve recruiting workflows, data quality, or operational efficiency.
  • Experience supporting Talent Acquisition Coordinators and building scalable coordination practices.
  • Experience leading recruiting programs, systems implementations, or cross-functional operational initiatives.

Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.

Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers.
But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences, across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions.

Our Solutions:

→ Actirise: the display tech designed for performance
→ FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes
→ Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks
→ Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution
→ Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:

  • FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025

  • The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups

  • Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.

  • We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.

  • We think as one: Collective goals come before personal wins.

  • We trade off: We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results.

  • We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

The Mission

As the Product Manager Flashbid / Dynamic Yield, you own the buy-side auction stack including our proprietary wrapper Flashbid on Actirise properties end-to-end. Your mission: continuously optimize yield while guaranteeing auction reliability and a fully compliant demand chain to drive incremental revenues and saving costs.

Your key responsibilities:

1. Wrapper & Auction Core

  • Own the Flashbid wrapper roadmap end-to-end: integration, evolution, and maintenance of the proprietary wrapper.

  • Monitor and optimize auction latency and performance — every millisecond of delay costs revenue.

  • Manage publisher demand connections: GAM, External RTB, and non-oRTB integrations.

2. Demand & Bidder Management

  • Own bidder setting configuration, integration, activation, and monitoring — both server-to-server (S2S) and client-side — including status monitoring and whitelisting per property.

  • Drive Shield: detect and block malicious or non-desired ads, and control the revenue impact of every blocking decision.

3. Yield Optimization

  • Own throttling and yield algorithms: pressure regulation, dynamic floor prices, smart refresh, and bid enrichment.

  • Partner with the Data team on AI-driven yield algorithms to push incremental revenue further.

  • Run structured A/B tests on yield levers (floor prices, bidder mix, throttling rules) and let data drive every decision.

4. Supply Chain & Compliance

  • Own SCHAIN: ads.txt management and vendor list curation to guarantee supply chain integrity.

  • Own the collection, processing, and transmission of consent signals (TCF, GPP) to demand partners.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with DPO on consent signal quality and compliance requirements feeding the auction.

  • Partner with PM Analytics to ensure auction/yield KPIs are properly tracked, benchmarked, and actionable.

  • Align with Supply, Data, and Tech/Engineering teams to prioritize the roadmap and ship reliably.

  • Act as the auction/yield product voice across Sparteo, translating technical trade-offs into clear business decisions for stakeholders and C-level.

Your profile for this job

We are looking for someone who treats every millisecond and every basis point of fill rate as money on the table — and who is as comfortable in a bid stream log as in a revenue dashboard.

  • PM Expertise: 4+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally on programmatic/header bidding products, SSPs, or yield management platforms.

  • Programmatic Expertise: Deep understanding of header bidding, RTB/OpenRTB, GAM, S2S vs. client-side bidding, and the SSP/DSP ecosystem.

  • Yield Mindset: Proven experience optimizing floor prices, throttling, or bidder mix to drive incremental revenue — you think in RPM, fill rate, win rate, and latency.

  • Supply Chain & Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with ads.txt/sellers.json, schain validation, and consent frameworks (TCF, GPP) as they apply to the demand chain.

  • Data-Driven: Strong analytical skills; comfortable running A/B tests on auction parameters and reading the results into concrete roadmap decisions. SQL basics are a plus.

  • Technical Literacy: Understanding of auction latency, bid streams, and wrapper architecture. You don't need to code, but you need to speak engineering's language fluently.

  • Performance Obsession: Treats auction reliability and latency as first-class product metrics, not afterthoughts.

  • Exceptional Communicator: Able to translate highly technical programmatic trade-offs into clear priorities for Tech, Supply, and C-level stakeholders.

  • A strategic thinker with an 'AI-native' reflex, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints. You don't just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision

Your mind set to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

  • 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment.

  • 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond.

  • 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Ready to join Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process!

Here are the stages in our recruitment process

  • Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  • Analytical and business logic tests

  • Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager

  • Taking up references

Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Android Engineer to join our Powered team and take ownership of our Android SDKs: the CQoE SDK, which telecom carriers and partners embed directly into their own apps to passively measure real-world network quality, and the Speedtest SDK, the core measurement library that powers every Speedtest client.

You will be responsible for implementing and maintaining features that perform a wide variety of network measurements on millions of Android devices. Much of this measurement logic lives in a shared C++ engine used across Android, iOS, and embedded targets, so you’ll have an opportunity to work across the Kotlin/Java, JNI/NDK, C++ boundary.

You love to code and appreciate well-designed APIs, as you will need to strike the right balance between SDK and application code. You have experience with Android platform, but are interested in both Android and iOS as well as embedded environments. You want to make a better Internet for everyone. If you already use Ookla’s tools to check your broadband or mobile data performance, now you have a chance to be a part of the team that produces them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain network measurement features in the CQoE and Speedtest Android SDKs, consumed by external carrier partners, third-party app developers, and internal client apps. This includes implementation, testing, documentation, deployment, and development support

  • Work across the JNI/NDK boundary into the shared C++ measurement engine used across Android, iOS, and embedded targets by debugging native code and, over time, contributing to and maintaining it directly

  • Bring AI-assisted tooling into coding, QA, and data analysis where it genuinely earns its place, with clear guardrails around safety, privacy, security, and verification

  • Stay hands-on where it counts (technical reviews, architecture discussions, targeted implementation) while taking ownership of delivery end-to-end on the features and fixes you drive

  • Roll out SDK and measurement changes deliberately: gate them behind feature flags, run quality checks, and verify post-release that real-world behavior matches intent before widening exposure

Job Requirements:

  • 5+ years of software development experience, with a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and design patterns

  • Experience with Android using Kotlin and Java

  • Substantial experience building and maintaining SDKs or libraries

  • Strong data literacy: comfortable writing SQL to investigate production and measurement data, using Python (or similar) for analysis, and applying data-quality monitoring practices to catch anomalies before they reach partners

  • A curious, proactive stance toward AI and modern engineering practices

  • Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, data analysis skills

  • Strong time management skills and a self-driven work ethic

Nice to have:

  • Experience with telecom/network measurement, QoE/QoS systems, or RF/cellular domain knowledge

  • Experience with iOS

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (IP, TCP/UDP, HTTP/S, WebSocket).

  • Experience with embedded systems using C++

About

Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.

About Accenture

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description:Are you a highly motivated individual with an analytical mindset?
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Are you a highly motivated individual with an analytical mindset? Are you well-versed in common data transformation techniques? Do you enjoy working with data as well as working with customers? Are you looking for a job where you can use new technologies to tighten and improve processes? Are you looking to make a splash as part of a small but growing team? If you answered “Yes” to all of those questions, then we’re looking for you!

The ideal candidate for this role will be extremely detail-oriented and demonstrate a strong passion for business intelligence and data transformation technologies to support the customers of a rapidly growing SaaS business.

The Customer Data Specialist is a part of the Customer Success team, otherwise known as FMX’s secret weapon. We stand out in the industry due to our world-class customer support, which has earned us a 98% customer satisfaction rating! Customer Data Specialists are meticulous in their work and exhibit high attention to detail. The primary objective of this role is to successfully manage end-to-end customer data migration projects from multiple sources during implementation. Customer Data Specialists are expected to take initiative, meet project deadlines, and provide timely responses to customer inquiries. You'll be working in a fast-paced, high-energy, and collaborative environment, where you'll be expected to show up every day and positively impact the company's strategy and culture. You can expect to dedicate 70% of your time to data migrations, 20% customer meetings, and 10% administering product trainings.

Responsibilities:

As a Customer Data Specialist, you will:

  • Act as a data migration subject matter expert on the Customer Success team
  • Complete end-to-end data migrations for FMX customers. This process includes extracting source data from external softwares and transforming it to fit FMX’s target data schema using tools such as Excel, Power Query, AI and others prior to completing the upload process in the FMX application
  • Be the go-to source for a customer’s data questions and needs during their implementation
  • Understand customer data needs and prioritize them accordingly
  • Attend customer-facing meetings with the Customer Success Implementation and Retention teams to ensure customers’ data requirements are being met
  • Become an expert in FMX’s core product, and lead technical module-based trainings for customers
  • Adhere to project priority procedures and completion deadlines
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously increase client satisfaction through professional and courteous service
  • Work cross-functionally across Customer Success Support, Implementation, and Retention teams to maintain consistent communication
  • Seek continuous improvement in process and utilize emerging technologies, like AI tooling, to serve our customers more effectively

Requirements

Experience & Qualities:

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Exceptional communication, attention to detail, time management, and organizational traits
  • An openness to learning new skills in data transformation technologies, including a high level of AI fluency
  • Creativity in using intelligent automation tools to complete repetitive tasks
  • Ability to manage a high volume of projects and meet deadlines
  • Comfortable hosting customer-facing meetings
  • Self-motivation and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, competitive environment
  • Embodiment of our core pillars: We value our work ethic, we are disciplined in our processes and responsibilities, we are coachable and seek out constructive criticism, we value results and are performance-driven, and we treat each other and everyone we meet with respect and integrity.

Tech Stack

  • FMX (We love our own product!)
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Slack
  • Zendesk
  • Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, etc.)
  • Claude
  • Notion AI

The hiring process for this role:

  • Apply! Submit your resume and answers to the application questions via the Workable portal.
  • Phone screen with PeopleOps: A 30-minute conversation to review your background and experiences, discuss the culture at FMX, and ensure that you understand the general expectations for the role. Also, a great time for you to ask questions about compensation, benefits, etc.
  • Hiring manager conversation: A 60-minute conversation with the Manager of Support Services and the Director of Customer Success. Be prepared to discuss your background as well as what you’re looking for in your next role and what direction you see your career path taking. This is a great time for you to ask questions about the expectations for this role, team culture, etc. Note: Following the Hiring Manager Conversation, there may be a data assessment project given, which will be reviewed in the first fifteen minutes of the Final Panel Interview.
  • Final Panel interview: A 45-minute, two part conversation. You can expect the first fifteen minutes to be dedicated to reviewing the data assessment project. The second portion of this interview will be a conversation with a few members of the Support Services team. This is a great time for you to ask questions about the team, life at FMX and get to know your potential teammates!

Benefits

FMX Benefits and Life at FMX:

  • You’ll make a big impact: You’ll have significant influence over the direction of our product and the future of our company.
  • Competitive benefits: 100% company-paid health, dental, vision insurance, long and short term disability, and life insurance.
  • Work from home: At FMX, we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We host one all-company event a year to ensure that you can put a face to a name and establish high-trust relationships with your teammates and coworkers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator.
  • Home office stipend: We’ll give you everything necessary to do your job (company-sponsored laptop, headset, etc.). We will also provide up to $500 to help with equipment, furniture, and accessories. You will also get $60/month toward your home internet connection.
  • Generous PTO and UTO (unplanned time off) policies: If you’re sick, why should that cut into your vacation time?
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible schedule to help you manage personal appointments, such as doctor or dentist visits, as long as you're meeting performance expectations and project timelines.
  • You can wear jeans and tees: Feel free to keep it casual, we do.
  • You’ll enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team: We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously.


Compensation:

    • The base salary range for this position is expected to be $52,250. There is also bonus potential, bringing on target earnings to $55,000.
    • 401(k) and medical / dental / vision / short and long term disability / life insurance

Other Considerations: The candidate for this position can be located anywhere in the US.

Company:

  • FMX is founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio and develops a cloud-based, software-as-a-service facility maintenance and management product. FMX serves education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets and is one of the fastest-growing companies in its space. Check us out at:
  • Note: All other company requirements are documented in the FMX Teammate Handbook. FMX is an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.
