jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryOdyssey is seeking a Capture Management Director to lead a high-performing team of Capture Managers responsible for identifying, shaping, and winning large federal business opportunities.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Odyssey is seeking a Capture Management Director to lead a high-performing team of Capture Managers responsible for identifying, shaping, and winning large federal business opportunities. Reporting to the Executive Director of Business Development and Capture, this leader will oversee the company’s capture portfolio and establish the priorities, processes, and operating discipline required to support sustained growth.

This is a leadership role focused on building and managing a world-class capture organization. The Director will lead Capture Managers pursuing significant opportunities across the U.S. Air Force, Army, Navy, Space and Missile Defense (SMD), and Life Sciences markets, with particular emphasis on large Full and Open competitions, major recompetes, and strategic growth opportunities.

The Director will work closely with the Executive Director of Business Development and Capture and senior company leadership to determine where Odyssey Systems should invest its time, people, and resources. This includes evaluating the opportunity pipeline, establishing capture priorities, assessing competitive positioning, and making informed recommendations on which pursuits should receive the organization’s highest level of investment.

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of how large federal procurements are won and the leadership ability to translate that knowledge into a consistent approach across the Capture Management team. The Director will establish common standards and best practices while giving Capture Managers the autonomy to develop strategies appropriate to their customers and opportunities.

This position requires a leader who can operate at two levels: managing the overall capture portfolio and developing the people responsible for individual pursuits, while personally engaging in the company's most important opportunities when executive leadership, customer relationships, or strategic intervention can influence the outcome.

Responsibilities

Duties include, but not limited to:

What You Will Do

Lead the Capture Organization

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Capture Managers responsible for major federal pursuits.
  • Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and priorities for the Capture Management team.
  • Build a culture that emphasizes accountability, collaboration, disciplined execution, and winning.
  • Develop Capture Managers through regular coaching, mentoring, pursuit reviews, and hands-on leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the team's capabilities, processes, tools, and talent.
  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm for capture reviews, pipeline assessments, strategy sessions, and leadership updates.

Manage and Prioritize the Capture Portfolio

  • Work with the Executive Director of Business Development and Capture to establish and maintain the company's strategic capture priorities.
  • Evaluate opportunities based on customer alignment, strategic value, contract size, competitive environment, probability of success, resource requirements, and potential return on investment.
  • Recommend where Odyssey Systems should invest, pursue, shape, accelerate, or walk away from opportunities.
  • Ensure Capture Managers remain focused on the opportunities that matter most to the company's growth objectives.
  • Maintain visibility into the health and maturity of the capture portfolio and identify issues requiring executive attention.
  • Balance near-term recompete activity with longer-term growth opportunities and market expansion.

Lead Large Federal Pursuits

  • Provide leadership and oversight for significant Full and Open opportunities, major recompetes, and other high-value federal competitions.
  • Ensure Capture Managers engage customers early and develop a strong understanding of mission requirements, acquisition strategies, funding, evaluation priorities, and competitive dynamics.
  • Challenge capture teams to develop solutions that are differentiated, executable, and aligned with what matters most to the customer.
  • Review and challenge capture strategies, competitive assessments, teaming approaches, win strategies, pricing strategies, and proposal plans.
  • Personally engage in the company's most strategic pursuits where senior leadership involvement can improve customer access, teaming relationships, competitive positioning, or probability of win.
  • Ensure critical decisions are made early enough to influence the acquisition rather than simply respond to the RFP.

Establish Capture Best Practices

  • Develop and implement a consistent capture framework for Odyssey Systems based on proven federal capture practices.
  • Establish common standards for opportunity qualification, capture planning, customer engagement, competitive analysis, solution development, teaming, pricing, and proposal transition.
  • Implement meaningful capture metrics and decision points that provide leadership with a clear view of opportunity health and risk.
  • Establish disciplined reviews that identify weaknesses early and drive corrective action before proposal submission.
  • Continuously improve the company's capture approach based on wins, losses, customer feedback, and lessons learned.

Partner Across the Business

  • Work closely with the Executive Director of Business Development and Capture to translate corporate growth objectives into actionable capture priorities.
  • Partner with Business Development, Operations, Engineering, Program Management, Pricing, Contracts, Recruiting, Finance, and Proposal teams to develop executable strategies.
  • Ensure capture strategies reflect Odyssey Systems' actual capabilities, resources, customer relationships, and ability to deliver.
  • Guide Capture Managers in developing effective teaming strategies and relationships with industry partners.
  • Engage senior executives at appropriate stages of major pursuits to ensure organizational alignment and timely decision-making.
  • Help position Odyssey Systems for opportunities before formal acquisition activity begins.

Drive Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct structured reviews of major wins, losses, and completed pursuits to identify lessons that can improve future performance.
  • Track capture performance and use data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Refine tools, processes, templates, and training programs used by the Capture Management organization.
  • Build a scalable capture function capable of supporting Odyssey Systems' continued growth without sacrificing discipline or quality.

Markets and Growth Focus

The Capture Management Director will oversee pursuits across a diverse set of federal markets, including:

  • U.S. Air Force
  • U.S. Army
  • U.S. Navy
  • Space and Missile Defense
  • Life Sciences

The immediate emphasis will be on building and winning a pipeline of large, strategically important Full and Open opportunities and major recompetes. The Director will help determine where Odyssey Systems can compete most effectively and how the company should position itself to expand its presence with existing customers and enter new markets.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success is more than winning individual contracts. The Capture Management Director will be expected to build a stronger, more capable capture organization and create a repeatable approach to pursuing large federal opportunities.

Success will include:

  • A focused and strategically prioritized capture portfolio.
  • Stronger Capture Managers and a deeper bench of capture leadership talent.
  • Consistent application of capture best practices across major pursuits.
  • Earlier and more meaningful customer engagement.
  • Improved competitive positioning and probability of win.
  • A healthy pipeline of large Full and Open opportunities and recompetes.
  • Better alignment between capture strategy and operational execution.
  • Increased capture efficiency and disciplined use of company resources.
  • Growth in contract awards and profitable revenue across Odyssey Systems' priority markets.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Management, or a related discipline.
  • 12+ years of experience in federal business development, capture management, or a combination of both.
  • Demonstrated success leading or overseeing large federal captures, preferably including $50M+ opportunities.
  • Experience leading and developing Capture Managers or other senior business development professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience with Full and Open federal competitions and major recompetes.
  • Experience with one or more of Odyssey Systems' target markets, including Air Force, Army, Navy, SMD, or Life Sciences.
  • Strong understanding of the federal acquisition process and the dynamics of large government procurements.
  • Proven ability to evaluate opportunities and make sound pursuit and resource-allocation decisions.
  • Strong understanding of capture methodology and disciplined pursuit management.
  • Executive-level communication skills with the ability to brief senior leadership, customers, and industry partners.
  • Strong customer relationship, negotiation, strategic planning, and team leadership skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on the organization's most important opportunities.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with large DoD procurements involving the Air Force, Army, Navy, or SMD.
  • Experience pursuing federal Life Sciences or health-related opportunities.
  • Demonstrated success with large Full and Open competitions.
  • Experience with major recompetes and incumbent displacement strategies.
  • Experience with IDIQ, GWAC, BPA, and task-order environments.
  • Experience with FFP, CPFF, T&M, and other federal contract structures.
  • Experience establishing or improving a formal capture management organization.
  • Experience implementing capture metrics, governance, and portfolio-management processes.

Company Overview

Odyssey is a world-class technical, engineering, and integration company serving the warfighting ecosystem with airborne integration, ISR, C2, and warfighter readiness capabilities. Odyssey meets the military’s operational needs by integrating layered defense systems from equipment, technology, and services to data, information, and business operations. We streamline defense acquisition and sustainment, engineering the technical battlefield with domain-specific proficiency to ensure lethality. Odyssey is dedicated to excellent contract execution, peak organizational performance, and fostering a workplace built on employee care.

Odyssey is proud to live out our core values of commitment, ambition, and respect in our work and communities through OdysseyCares, a philanthropic group focused on giving back through direct donations, an employer match program, and volunteering events.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

Please Note:

Final compensation for this position will be determined by various factors such as the Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant work experience, specific skills and competencies, geographic location, education, and certifications.

This position is filled through continuous recruitment and will remain open until a sufficient pool of applications has been received.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, Tricare supplement, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, employee assistance program, learning and development benefit, paid time off, and holidays.Odyssey Benefits

Job Title: Senior SharePoint Administrator/Developer

Location:Remote, US

Employment Type:Full-Time

**Contingent upon contract award**

About mcfa:

We are a professional services firm in the Architecture/Engineering/ Construction (AEC) industry serving public and private sector clients in the Mid-Atlantic region. Our services include Strategy, Planning, Program Management & Construction Management. Our goal is to help every employee design a fulfilling career through aligning their individual passions/skills with the vision of the organization. Our mission is "Inspiring People and Places through Project Leadership and Project Development".

mcfa Core Values (LEADS):

  • Love (each other, mission, work)
  • Entrepreneurial (spirit of innovation)
  • Accountability (to ourselves, our clients, each other)
  • Delight (customers and teammates)
  • Stretch (individual and collective growth mindset)

How you'll get to contribute:

mcfa is seeking a hands-on SharePoint Architect/Administrator to support the VA Office of Capital Asset Management (OCAMS) program. OCAMS runs on a SharePoint environment that VA uses to track capital project data across its national portfolio — the same data that feeds VA's Strategic Capital Investment Planning (SCIP) process and, through it, the department's capital budget requests to Congress. When that site is slow, broken, or wrong, the people who feel it are field staff at medical centers and the analysts assembling budget submissions.

Our ideal candidate is a SharePoint practitioner who is equally comfortable debugging a broken calculated column and designing a reporting dashboard a senior executive will actually use — and who can then write the manual that lets the government administer the site without calling us.

You will serve as the technical lead for Task 3 (SharePoint Enhancements) and provide the SharePoint expertise behind Task 4 (Training Development Tools). This position is contingent upon the award of the proposed contract.

What you'll get to do:

  • Clear the known-issues backlog. Remediate every defect on the government-furnished known-issues list — home page problems, individual project page errors, document library behavior, and FTEE calculation errors — with all fixes delivered within 60 days of award.
  • Own defect intake for the life of the contract. Stand up a repeatable identify-triage-fix-verify process that closes newly reported issues within 30 days of identification, and keep the COR informed on status without being chased for it.
  • Design the reporting layer. Build dashboards that let a user start at the national portfolio view and drill down through VISN, project, and station without exporting anything to Excel.
  • Rebuild the individual project pages. Add IPT membership lists, IOTA and CFM Planner data fields, and phased-delivery indicators — and smart-link the data so a value entered once populates everywhere it belongs instead of being retyped.
  • Deliver the quality-of-life fixes that make the site trustworthy: column header tooltips that explain what a field actually means, VISN-level mouse-over project summaries, and automated site backups.
  • Write the administrator technical manual so the COR can configure and adjust site settings independently, support development of the field-user manuals covering the site's core functions, and refresh both on a 90-day cycle as the site changes.
  • Work inside VA's Microsoft Government cloud environment and stay inside it — VA security, configuration, and change-control requirements govern the solution, not the fastest available third-party add-in.
  • Coordinate with the Program Manager, Project Manager, and financial staff so what the site reports reconciles with the funding figures going into the Budget Call and the quarterly and mid-year activation funding estimates.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent hands-on experience considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 5+ years administering and developing SharePoint, including at least 3 years on SharePoint Online / Microsoft 365.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and fix what breaks in real SharePoint sites: calculated column and formula errors, list and library performance at scale, permissions inheritance, and broken page layouts.
  • SharePoint Framework (SPFx), PnP PowerShell, or Microsoft Graph / REST API development.
  • Working proficiency with Power BI (or an equivalent reporting tool), Power Automate, and Power Apps.
  • Proven ability to write technical documentation a non-technical government administrator can follow without help.
  • Able to obtain and maintain a VA Public Trust background investigation.
  • U.S. citizenship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior SharePoint work for VA or another federal health system, or familiarity with SCIP, VISN structure, or federal capital planning and activation funding.
  • Experience in a Microsoft Government cloud environment (GCC or GCC High) or another FedRAMP-authorized tenant.
  • Experience modernizing classic SharePoint sites and migrating content without breaking downstream reporting.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications — MS-102, PL-300, PL-400, or a SharePoint-focused credential.
  • Experience training government users and running a help-desk-style intake queue.

What's in it for you:

Annual Paid Time Off:

  • Sick Leave: 5 Days (40 Hours)
  • Vacation: 15 Days (120 Hours)
  • Holidays: 11 Federal Holidays (88 Hours) observed in accordance with mcfa's Holiday Schedule

"mcfa way" Bonus Program:

  • Following your first full quarter worked, you will qualify for a profit-share bonus that is distributed at the end of each quarter if company targets are hit.
  • Incoming Growth Units: 10
  • Growth Unit allotment may increase over time.

Healthcare & Insurance:

  • Eligible to participate in mcfa’s family medical, dental and vision coverage; plan access begins on the first day of employment.
    • mcfa contributes up to 75% shared cost, not to exceed $700 per month.
  • Company paid life insurance plan (up to $100,000 per employee).
  • Company paid short-term and long-term disability insurance.

Retirement

  • You are eligible to participate in Company retirement plan (401k) on first day of employment with mcfa.

References and/or work samples may be requested.

This position is subject to client review and approval.

mcfa is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. mcfa does not discriminate against any applicant or employee with regard to hiring, tenure of employment, promotion, transfer, selection for training, or any other terms or conditions of employment because of race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity or national origin, status as a Vietnam-era or special disabled veteran in accordance with applicable federal law, or on any ground protected by state or local law in each area in which mcfa maintains facilities.

  • Establishes and maintains collaborative relationships with investigative sites and site networks to facilitate study start-up, site engagement, and ongoing site support

Na tym stanowisku zajmujesz się konfiguracją i utrzymaniem środowisk IT, diagnostyką problemów, analizą logów oraz automatyzacją zadań administracyjnych przy wykorzystaniu Bash. Pracujesz również z wirtualizacją, sieciami i technologiami storage, a także wspierasz zdalną administrację systemami i współpracę z klientami z całego świata.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.excerpt: Our StoryAt Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline.
jobs.description:
Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline. Our software empowers sales associates to have more personal, effective conversations with customers through AI-powered tools that drive measurable revenue.

Despite retail being 6x larger than eCommerce, most platforms overlook the in-store experience. We’re changing that. We’re helping brands like Reformation, Gorjana, Glossier, Frame, and Mizzen+Main turn real customer relationships into growth powered by intuitive software and thoughtful design.

With rapid growth ahead, we’re scaling our Product organization and need a steady, capable leader to help us get there.

Position Overview

Endear is hiring a VP of Product to take day-to-day ownership of the product organization during a pivotal phase of growth. Partnering closely with leadership on long-term vision, you will translate company goals into clear product priorities and lead execution against the agreed mission.

This role is central to making Endear’s product team AI-native. You will improve how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, make decisions, and accelerate shipping—not just shape Endear’s AI product direction. You will bring a zero-to-one mindset, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and build the operating model needed for product, design, and engineering to move faster together.

This is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You will lead and develop the product team, partner deeply with Design and Engineering, assess team structure and resourcing, and hire additional product talent as needed. We are looking for someone who has shipped products in lean environments, can go deep when needed, and knows how to build scalable processes without adding unnecessary overhead

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take clear day-to-day ownership of product, turning company priorities into an actionable roadmap and measurable outcomes.

  • Align leadership, Product, Design, and Engineering around a cohesive product vision and a clear path to execution.

  • Assess the current team, operating model, and resourcing; identify what needs to change to improve speed, ownership, and accountability.

  • Establish stronger product rituals and decision-making systems that help the team ship with more focus and less friction.

  • Build practical customer-feedback loops into roadmap and prioritization decisions.

  • Make the product organization more AI-native by improving how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, prioritize, and ship.

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build a high-performing product organization with clear ownership, strong psychological safety, and the right team structure for the next stage.

  • Hire and develop product talent, including an additional PM, while evaluating the capabilities and resourcing the team needs.

  • Deliver high-impact roadmap work that improves product adoption and business outcomes.

  • Establish scalable planning, execution, and communication systems that keep teams aligned as Endear grows.

  • Help shape and execute Endear’s AI product direction while ensuring the team can move quickly from idea to shipped product.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

You Have Experience With

  • Leading product at a lean B2B SaaS company, with both strategic ownership and hands-on execution.

  • Turning company goals into clear product priorities, success metrics, and decisions.

  • Building and communicating product vision, then translating it into focused execution.

  • Partnering deeply with Design and Engineering, including going technical when needed.

  • Leading, mentoring, and growing Product Managers while maintaining a high bar for delivery.

  • Building product processes that add clarity and speed without creating unnecessary overhead.

  • Using AI tools in day-to-day product work—from research and problem framing to prototyping, prioritization, and execution.

  • Transforming how product teams work in an AI-native environment.

  • Using customer feedback, usage data, and market insight to guide roadmap decisions.

  • Operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving growth-stage environments.

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: Prioritize real customer problems over internal assumptions. Use research, feedback, and product data to ensure the roadmap delivers meaningful value to merchants and sales associates.

  • Take Ownership: Own outcomes, not just outputs. Take responsibility for product direction, team performance, and the impact product decisions have on the business.

  • Enable Autonomy: Build clear product strategy, priorities, and processes so product, design, and engineering teams can execute with confidence and independence.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: Set realistic expectations for product initiatives and deliver consistent, measurable improvements that build trust with customers and the team.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: Balance thoughtful strategy with a bias toward action. Test ideas, iterate quickly, and ship improvements that create real business impact.

About the Team

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Executive Team: Align product strategy with company goals, provide visibility into roadmap priorities and performance, and partner on key decisions around growth and product direction.

  • Head of Product Design: strategy, feedback, and design system development

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, and merchant needs

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

We’re a small team with big ambitions—collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  • Recruiter Screen

  • Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager + Co-Founder

  • Panel interview with key Product and Engineering team members

  • Final conversation with Co-Founder + CTO

  • Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $190+240k

  • Equity Eligible

  • Fully remote team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. We care about skills, motivation, and how you think more than we do about perfect resumes.

SUMMARY

This position is responsible for partnering with prospective and existing clients’ executive leadership teams to educate, explore and evaluate compensation programs and practices and their application to a specific client’s business. This position consults and collaborates with a client’s executive leadership on the development or revision of the company’s compensation strategy and initiatives in support of their business goals and objectives. Support for clients’ compensation strategies and initiatives include, but are not limited to: evaluation of existing pay programs; identification of client’s key business goals; objectives and performance indicators; development of compensation philosophy and alignment with compensation strategy; development of performance, reward and incentive systems; design of commission and sales incentive plans; design of bonus programs, including spot, sign-on, referral and retention bonus programs; development of compensation philosophy statements; support with allocating and implementing merit pay program; conducting pay equity analyses. As a senior-level team member, the consultant will mentor associate and specialist team members and serve as a subject matter expert for specific client compensation needs.

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

OVERVIEW

Every year, people across the world spend nearly one trillion dollars on groceries. But food is more than sustenance — it's identity, ritual, culture, and care. The way we eat shapes our health, our routines, and our relationships. Yet for most people, translating a desire to eat better or live healthier into actual, lasting habit change remains hard.

The Instacart Consumer team is at the forefront of reimagining how people relate to food at home. We're building new product experiences around meals, nutrition, and health that go beyond the transaction — helping people discover what to cook, build routines that stick, and feel confident in the choices they make for themselves and their families.

As a Staff Researcher on the Consumer team, you will shape the foundational understanding of how and why people change (or struggle to change) their food behaviors. You'll lead research that spans the full arc from generative discovery to iterative product testing, partnering closely with product, design, data science, marketing, and engineering to build products grounded in deep human insight. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for a researcher who is as comfortable in the messiness of early-stage innovation as they are in the rigor of quantitative validation.

ABOUT THE JOB

  • Independently own and drive the research roadmap for the consumer innovation workstream, partnering across product, design, data science, and engineering leadership to surface where research can shape strategy, unlock new opportunities, and push innovation
  • Lead generative, foundational research to understand how people think about food, nutrition, and health — including mental models, motivations, barriers, and behavioral triggers
  • Apply behavioral science frameworks (e.g., habit loops, nudge theory, behavior change models) to frame research questions and surface insights that fuel creative problem-solving and unlock new directions for product and design
  • Execute and oversee rigorous mixed-methods research: qualitative studies (in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation, diary studies, co-creation) alongside quantitative approaches (surveys, behavioral data analysis, concept testing at scale)
  • Translate research into compelling, actionable narratives that move stakeholders to decisions, from early-stage opportunity framing to product launch validation
  • Own and evolve the team's understanding of the consumer, maintaining living knowledge bases, personas, and journey maps that the broader organization draws on
  • Mentor junior researchers and contribute to the craft, culture, and standards of the Instacart research organization
  • Be a visible advocate for the customer across the organization, influencing roadmap and strategy through the quality and clarity of insights

ABOUT YOU

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years conducting UX or consumer research in a product organization, with meaningful experience in early-stage innovation or new product development
  • Background or deep familiarity with behavioral psychology, behavioral economics, or related fields - you understand the science of how habits form, persist, and change, and you bring that lens to your work
  • Expertise across a wide range of qualitative methodologies: in-depth interviews, ethnographic and diary studies, usability testing, participatory design, and workshop facilitation
  • Equally strong with quantitative methods: survey design and analysis, behavioral data interpretation, experimental design, and synthesis across mixed-methods studies
  • Proven ability to lead foundational, generative research — going beyond feature validation to define the opportunity space and shape product strategy
  • Exceptional storyteller: you turn nuanced human insight into crisp, compelling narratives that drive alignment and action at all levels of the organization
  • Experience working with or alongside data science teams to triangulate behavioral patterns from usage data with qualitative findings
  • Track record of influencing product roadmaps, not just informing them — you know how to position research to land with impact
  • Fluency using AI tools to accelerate iterative research cycles — from faster synthesis and screener development to rapid concept testing — while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Advanced degree preferred (Psychology, Behavioral Science, Cognitive Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Anthropology, or a related field); Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, grocery, CPG, or subscription products where lifecycle, personalization, and repeat behavior are critical
  • Research experience on high-visibility consumer surfaces such as home feeds, personalized browse, and merchandising placements — including how users navigate density, information hierarchy, and above/below-the-fold content
  • Background researching and informing onboarding, activation, and retention journeys that build habits, loyalty, and trust
  • Familiarity with AI-powered, agentic, or conversational product experiences and the ability to study how users engage with them — including novel methods for researching AI interactions
  • Ability to influence outcomes on multi-team initiatives without direct authority — you know how to build the coalitions that make research land
  • Familiarity with meal planning, nutrition, health goals, or dietary restriction management and how they intersect with household grocery behavior

jobs.description:
About Intellect

Intellect is a leading mental health benefits company, trusted by forward-thinking employers, insurers and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised and effective at scale. Today, we serve more than 4 million people across over 100 countries through our technology platform and global network of clinical providers.

Our platform supports workforces at companies including Dell, ByteDance, Visa, Shell, McDonald’s and hundreds more, enabling organisations to provide accessible, culturally relevant and high-quality mental healthcare to their people.

Driven by our mission to make mental healthcare accessible to everyone, Intellect combines technology, clinical care and local expertise to deliver meaningful outcomes across diverse markets and populations.

The Role

Australia is a priority growth market for Intellect, where we have established a strong and growing corporate mental health benefits business. We are now expanding our work across the insurance and workers’ compensation ecosystem.

Building on Intellect’s Australian presence, enterprise relationships, technology platform and clinical capabilities, the Market Development Lead will shape and execute this expansion, develop differentiated solutions, and convert priority opportunities into meaningful revenue and scalable programmes.

This is a market-building and commercial role spanning strategy, proposition development, business development, partnerships and execution. You will develop a deep understanding of the ecosystem, identify the most attractive segments and use cases, and translate them into compelling offerings, commercial models and routes to market.

You will be expected not only to shape the strategy, but also to originate and convert commercial opportunities. This includes building a qualified pipeline, leading customer development, securing paid engagements and remaining accountable as successful programmes move towards scale.

You will also help shape the operating capabilities, clinical and service-delivery models, technology, data, partnerships and team requirements that support effective execution and sustainable growth.

This is not an advisory or research-oriented position. You will be responsible for moving from market insight and opportunity identification through to customer conversion, implementation and measurable outcomes.

This opportunity may suit a management consultant with meaningful experience across insurance, workers’ compensation or adjacent healthcare sectors who is ready to become a hands-on operator. It may equally suit an industry professional who has demonstrated the ability to build new propositions, partnerships, capabilities or areas of business.

This is a senior, high-ownership role working closely with Intellect’s Australia leadership, Partnerships team and broader product, clinical and operational functions. As the business develops, there may be an opportunity to take on broader commercial or operating ownership and build or lead the capabilities required to support it.

Your Responsibilities

Develop the Market Strategy

  • Build a detailed understanding of Australia’s insurance and workers’ compensation ecosystem, including its participants, incentives, funding flows, buyers and decision-makers
  • Understand how psychological-injury services are currently procured, delivered and monetised, and where existing models are underperforming
  • Identify and prioritise the jurisdictions, customer segments, use cases and opportunities where Intellect can create the strongest clinical and commercial value
  • Assess market size, competitive dynamics, buying processes, regulatory considerations and barriers to adoption
  • Translate market insight into a focused development strategy, clear priorities and a staged commercial roadmap

Develop Solutions and Commercial Models

  • Identify unmet customer and claimant needs and translate them into differentiated products, services and propositions
  • Work with product, clinical, operations, commercial and other teams to develop solutions that are valuable to customers and viable for Intellect to deliver
  • Build the strategic, financial and operating case for priority opportunities
  • Develop appropriate pricing, contracting, funding and delivery models for different customers and use cases
  • Validate and refine propositions with insurers, employers, scheme participants, partners and other stakeholders to strengthen commercial and delivery viability
  • Define the clinical, operational and commercial outcomes required to demonstrate value and support broader adoption

Build and Convert Commercial Opportunities

  • Map the relevant buyers, budget owners, procurement routes and commercial decision-making processes across insurers, schemes, claims-service providers, employers and self-insurers
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline of priority commercial opportunities
  • Lead customer discovery and co-design conversations that translate buyer needs into viable solutions
  • Own opportunities from initial engagement through proposition development, proposal, negotiation, pilot and commercial agreement
  • Work closely with Intellect’s Partnerships and other commercial teams while remaining directly accountable for the progress and conversion of this market
  • Establish clear commercial goals and track pipeline quality, conversion, expected revenue and time to close
  • Convert priority opportunities into paid engagements that generate revenue, evidence and referenceable outcomes for broader market expansion

Build Strategic Relationships and Partnerships

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across insurers, workers’ compensation schemes, employers, brokers, claims-service providers, healthcare providers and other relevant organisations
  • Represent Intellect credibly in senior customer and ecosystem conversations
  • Identify partnerships that strengthen Intellect’s proposition, distribution, delivery capabilities or market access
  • Structure partnerships with clear strategic value, commercial logic, responsibilities and success measures
  • Use market relationships to deepen Intellect’s understanding of customer priorities and accelerate viable opportunities

Strengthen Delivery and Scale

  • Move priority opportunities from concept into defined pilots, programmes and commercial engagements
  • Shape how Intellect combines its existing capabilities, targeted hiring and strategic partners to support successful delivery at scale
  • Define the required operating model across clinical delivery, provider coverage, service operations, technology, data and reporting, customer management and governance
  • Ensure priority opportunities account for relevant clinical, regulatory and jurisdiction-specific requirements
  • Coordinate across commercial, product, clinical, operations, legal, finance and technology teams to implement programmes effectively
  • Track clinical, operational and commercial outcomes and use the results to improve the proposition and establish repeatable playbooks
  • Develop a staged capability roadmap aligned with validated demand and commercial progress

Requirements

  • You typically have approximately 5-12 years of relevant experience across management consulting, insurance, workers’ compensation, claims, healthcare, occupational health, market development or commercial strategy
  • You may come from consulting, with meaningful experience advising organisations across Australia’s insurance, workers’ compensation or adjacent healthcare ecosystem, or from an industry role in which you have built new propositions, partnerships, capabilities or areas of business
  • Regardless of background, you bring a strong understanding of how the relevant ecosystem operates, or clear evidence that you can develop that depth rapidly
  • You have repeatedly demonstrated that you can build from ambiguity, moving from problem definition and strategy through to commercialisation and implementation
  • You understand how complex services are bought, funded and delivered, and can identify the stakeholders who materially influence commercial decisions
  • You have experience originating and advancing complex B2B or B2B2C opportunities, including developing propositions, navigating multiple stakeholders and securing commercial commitment
  • You have strong strategic and commercial judgement and can distinguish genuinely attractive opportunities from interesting but low-value possibilities
  • You can structure complex problems, conduct rigorous analysis and translate insight into clear priorities and action
  • You can develop new propositions and commercial models rather than relying only on established products or sales playbooks
  • You are credible with senior external stakeholders and can build trusted relationships across a complex ecosystem
  • You can move from market strategy into detailed implementation and remain accountable for commercial and operating outcomes
  • You understand that successful market development requires strong internal delivery capabilities, not only external relationships
  • You can work effectively across product, clinical, commercial, operational and technical teams without relying solely on formal authority
  • You combine high standards with low ego, sound judgement and a willingness to work through operational detail
  • Experience in mental health, psychological injury, injury management, occupational rehabilitation, employee benefits or digital health is helpful

Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to build a significant area of growth while improving how people experiencing psychological injury receive timely, effective support.

Why Join Intellect

  • Help shape Intellect’s next phase of growth in one of its most important markets
  • Expand and commercialise a meaningful opportunity across Australia’s insurance and workers’ compensation ecosystem
  • Take ownership across the full journey from market strategy and proposition development to revenue, implementation and scale
  • Build on Intellect’s existing Australian presence, enterprise relationships, technology platform and clinical capabilities
  • Work directly with senior leaders and experienced teams across Australia and the broader Intellect organisation
  • Influence not only how Intellect goes to market, but also the capabilities and operating model required to deliver successfully
  • Build a platform for broader commercial or operating ownership as the opportunity develops
  • Apply your experience to improving access, recovery and outcomes for people experiencing psychological injury

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
  • Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
  • Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
  • Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
  • Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
  • Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
  • Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
  • Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
  • Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
  • Socialsand communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using the real-time insights about adversaries, their relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses. The company’s platform collects, interprets, structures, and validates human-led, automation-enhanced intelligence, which fuels our external attack surface and advanced behavioral threat hunting solutions. Customers utilize this operationalized intelligence to drive a proactive response to neutralize threats and mitigate risk. Organizations across the globe leverage Intel 471’s world-class intelligence, our trusted practitioner engagement and enablement, and globally-dispersed ground expertise as their frontline guardian against the ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats to fight the adversary — and win.

The Role

Intel 471 is looking for an IT Operations Support Specialist to own IT support for our colleagues outside Europe. The role reports to the Director, Infrastructure & Security. We can hire for this role in either the Americas or APAC. The successful candidate will work their local business hours.

The role is offered on a B2B contractor basis, and is available in six countries only. These are Brazil, Canada, and Panama in the Americas, and Australia, India, and Indonesia in APAC. You must be based in one of these countries and legally able to work from there. We cannot consider applications from other locations unfortunately.

We are a fully remote company and our IT support runs on European hours today. This role exists to close that gap. You will be the person our colleagues in your region come to when something in their setup stops working, and for a good part of your day you will be the IT person who is online. That independence is the point of the role.

The work is end-user IT support and the account and device lifecycle behind it: the support queue, onboarding and offboarding, laptops from order through enrollment, and getting people unblocked quickly when access breaks. You will also have real room to automate the requests we handle over and over, rather than working through them by hand.

Key Responsibilities

End-user support

  • Own the IT support queue for your region through our service desk, from first response to resolution, and keep the requests that need another team moving rather than parked.
  • Be the unblock path when someone cannot work: an expired SSO session, a locked laptop, a first-day account that is not ready, access that stopped working.
  • Support our estate day to day, which is macOS first, with Linux and cross-platform tools alongside it.

Accounts and access

  • Run the hands-on half of onboarding: create accounts, assign licenses and groups, get the new joiner into Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian and 1Password, and make sure their first day works.
  • Run offboarding to the documented order of operations, including transfers before suspension, per-application session and token revocation, and the follow-up checks in the days after an exit.
  • Administer Google Workspace users, groups and aliases, and handle access requests against the policy Security sets. You run the requests. Access policy, and the automation behind the lifecycle, sit with the Security team.

Devices

  • Order, ship and track hardware for your region, and keep the asset record accurate.
  • Enroll and verify devices in MDM (Mosyle), including disk encryption, the managed application baseline and secure access through Cloudflare WARP.
  • Keep endpoint tooling coverage complete across the fleet and chase the machines that fall out of it.

Automation and documentation

  • Automate the repeatable requests instead of absorbing them. A large share of our current ticket volume is a single templated request type, and removing that class of work is the highest-impact thing available in this role.
  • Keep runbooks, standard operating procedures and knowledge base articles current, at a level where someone else can pick the work up.

Working across the company

  • Work with Security on endpoint compliance, access reviews and incident support, and with DevOps where a request touches infrastructure.
  • Communicate clearly about status and timing to people who are not technical and, in many cases, are not native English speakers.

Scope and escalation

  • You own IT support in your region end to end and you decide how the work inside it is sequenced.
  • Security policy, cloud infrastructure and production systems are not part of this role. Those go to the Security team and to DevOps.

Ideal Profile

  • IT operations experience: 3 to 5 years in IT operations, technical support or service desk environments, in an organization where you were close to the end users rather than behind a tiered queue.
  • Endpoint support: Hands-on supporting macOS as the primary platform, with Linux and cross-platform environments alongside it.
  • SaaS administration: Practical Google Workspace administration, plus the common stack around it - Slack, Atlassian, Zoom, 1Password.
  • Device management: Hands-on with an MDM platform for endpoint management and compliance. We run Mosyle; equivalent experience with Jamf, Kandji or Intune transfers.
  • Identity and access: Solid understanding of identity and access management, escalation paths and service request workflows.
  • Automation mindset: Comfortable in at least one scripting language (for example Python or Bash) and willing to spend time removing manual work rather than repeating it.
  • AI-forward: We work with AI heavily, so you must be comfortable using AI and LLM tools day to day to write scripts, summarize logs and improve workflows, and be genuinely open to learning more.
  • Works independently: You will often be the only IT person online in your hours. You need to be comfortable making the call, and clear about which calls need to be escalated.
  • Clear communicator: Strong written communication, good documentation habits, and patience with people who are having a bad day with their laptop.
  • Team player: Integrity, and able to handle urgent requests and high-pressure situations while staying flexible and focused.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in information systems, a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of IT service management (ITSM) principles. ITIL certification is a plus.
  • Experience with workflow automation tooling (for example n8n, Zapier or similar).
  • Experience supporting a fully remote, distributed company across timezones.
  • Certifications such as Google IT Support, Apple ACSP, CompTIA A+ or Network+.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • Wellness programs
  • Employee recognition program
  • A variety of professional development opportunities
  • Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation

Our Culture

The Intel 471 team is constantly growing and is always on the lookout for talented professionals who seek to operate on the forefront of the fight against threat actors impacting our customers and partners. Our culture of humility and quiet professionalism is a core attribute of Intel 471 and everyone within it. Our culture is collaborative, supportive and fast-paced. We're a mission-driven company. We're looking for talented, 'can-do' minded people with a passion for always doing the right thing.

We believe in supporting a progressive culture that allows all our people to be themselves, enjoy exciting opportunities and grow with us. That's why our culture is founded on our core values of openness, inclusion, integrity and client focus, which set the tone for how we work together and treat each other in order to empower us all and foster a unique team spirit. View our Culture Guide to find out more about us and what it's like to work for Intel 471!

jobs.title: Senior VCISO
jobs.excerpt: At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them.
jobs.description:
At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them. We serve hundreds of municipalities and organizations across the United States and Canada, bringing IT to the people who need it most. We believe in earning trust, having a growth mindset, and delivering excellence every single time.
We're a team of doers, builders, and tech whisperers who live by 4 core values:
Go Beyond | Own It | Be Curious| Serve as One
We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar.
The Impact you will have:

The Senior Virtual Chief Information Security Officer(Senior vCISO) will provide strategic leadership and oversight for the information security programs of VC3 managed clients. This role involves having a deep understanding of each client’s unique business environment to develop tailored strategies that mitigate risks and align with client business objectives. The Senior vCISO is a top security expert that works with existing management and technical teams both within client environments and VC3 to manage risks and safeguard the company’s and clients’ data, while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. This role also assists in providing strategy for the Managed Security space to drive growth, delivery with consistency and excellence, and the desired level of profitability for the organization. Key focus areas are innovation, staying at or ahead of world events that are relevant, consistent excellence, proactiveness, and driving efficiency. By measuring progress and adjusting processes accordingly, the Senior vCISO keeps the clients under their purview on track.

The Managed Security department at VC3 is responsible for ensuring our clients have the right security tools, policies and processes to thrive in today’s fast-moving threat landscape. They ensure that our internal teams are equipped with the training and knowledge to support our clients and make sure that effective security is a key aspect of everything we do within VC3.

In order to ensure an exceptional result, you will need to have a clear understanding of the challenges and opportunities our clients face and how our teams as a whole combine to deliver our promise. Providing services in a proactive, professional manner while ensuring key parties are kept informed is critical. We are a data driven company and analysis for decision making and overall strategy is ongoing.

What you will be doing:

  • Understand and follow “The VC3 Way”. This is our set of standards and processes that produce a predictable result for the client. You must be aware of and maintain our standards.
  • Engage and provide consulting services to mid-market and enterprise clients, including:
    • Provide strategic leadership in translating complex cybersecurity concepts into non-technical terms for clients to clearly understand specific applications to their business priorities.
    • Understand and align with the client organization’s overall strategy and business environment to ensure cybersecurity initiatives support business objectives
    • Lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy for clients and VC3 that aligns with the organization’s goals and objectives
    • Proactively identify and anticipate future security and compliance challenges for our clients and VC3, driving VC3 solutions
    • Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate security into product design and implementation, and to develop security solution offerings for clients.
    • Drive the creation and execution of a robust cybersecurity plan and program within client environments, ensuring alignment with industry best practices.
    • Assist in the development of the information security incident response program for the VC3 Managed Security Department.
    • Strategically develop and enhance client specific incident response programs as needed based on the development of Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery practices liaising with internal VC3 Departments as necessary.
    • Lead comprehensive cybersecurity risk assessments based on the client organization’s assets, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend remediation strategies.
    • Collaborate within VC3 and with clients to assist with vendor selection, providing guidance and checklists to ensure third party security compliance.
  • Engage and provide services to VC3 as an organization, including:
    • Security Strategy & Vision:
    • Develop and implement a comprehensive information security strategy for internal operations and client-facing services.
    • Collaborate with senior management to align security initiatives with business objectives and regularly report on the status of security programs and initiatives.
    • Drive the adoption of security policies, standards, and guidelines that protect the company and its clients.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify, evaluate, and report on information security risks in a manner that meets compliance and regulatory requirements.
    • Oversee risk assessments and mitigation strategies for both internal environments.
  • Compliance & Regulatory Oversight:
    • Ensure the organization complies with all relevant regulations, standards, and certifications (e.g., SOC II, FISMA, NIST).
    • Lead audits and assessments to maintain compliance and certification standards.
  • Incident Response & Management:
    • Establish and oversee the organization’s incident response program, including detection, investigation, and remediation of security incidents.
    • Coordinate with legal, public relations, and other relevant teams to manage communication during and after a security breach.
    • Post-incident, lead efforts to identify root causes and implement changes to prevent future incidents.
Additional Responsibilities:
  • Foster a security-conscious culture across the organization, ensuring all employees understand their role in protecting information.
  • Serve as the security spokesperson to clients, partners, and regulatory bodies.
  • Proactively engage with industry peers and continuously analyze and review new security technologies and understand emerging security threats while implementing proactive measures to mitigate potential risks.
  • Strategically collaborate with internal stakeholders to stay informed of planned changes to technologies, practices, and business activities that could impact security.
  • Collaborate across all VC3 departments to maximize our client security posture and experience during onboarding, system design, strategy and ongoing support
  • Maintain precise and up-to-date timesheets, and document notes on troubleshooting steps and client communications.
  • Actively seek and reflect on feedback from stakeholders, colleagues, and management using it to drive improvement.
  • Escalate complex issues to senior resources or relevant teams when necessary.
  • Engage actively in team huddles, L10 meetings, and other collaboratively structured meetings.
  • Develop and revise documentation promptly to reflect changes or new findings.
  • Attend company-based meetings as required
  • Additional duties as assigned

Performance Deliverables:
Each employee’s performance is tracked through both leading and lagging key performance metrics:
  • Client & VC3 Cyber Security Incidents
  • Client Utilization
  • Security MRR Growth
  • Client & VC3 Security Awareness Education

The tools you bring:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree (preferred) in an IT-based curriculum, or at least 10 years’ experience in risk management, information security, or programming.
  • One or more of the following qualifications: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information systems Auditor (CISA), or Certified Risk & Information Security Controls (CRISC), Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) or equivalent
  • Extensive experience in cybersecurity strategy development, risk management, and program administration.
  • Deep knowledge of current common cybersecurity frameworks (CIS, NIST, MITRE ATT&CK)
  • Expertise in compliance and regulatory requirements across various industries.
  • An understanding of SIEM platforms, perimeter security, endpoint detection and response platforms, vulnerability management solutions, all aspects of IT infrastructure (compute, route/switch, security) and cloud security
  • Possesses a high level of self-motivation and initiative, consistently taking ownership of tasks and projects.
  • Demonstrate a strong sense of autonomy and resourcefulness, capable of making independent decisions and solving problems without relying heavily on coaching or direction.
  • Exhibit excellent time management and organizational skills, effectively prioritizing tasks and allocating resources to meet deadlines and achieve objectives without extensive oversight.
  • Displays a proactive and self-directed approach to learning and staying updated on industry trends, seeking out relevant information and resources to enhance their knowledge and skills.
  • Shows the ability to adapt and thrive in ambiguous or uncertain situations, quickly assessing and navigating challenges.
  • Possesses strong critical thinking and decision-making abilities, evaluating complex situations and determining the best course of action, while considering the broader organizational goals and objectives.
  • Demonstrates effective communication skills, both written and verbal, articulating ideas and expectations clearly and concisely, minimizing the need for frequent guidance or clarification.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage relationships with clients (internal and external) through consistent and proactive communication.
  • Extraordinarily strong interpersonal skills, able to build effective working relationships, solicit co-operation and collaborate with various stakeholders internally and externally.
Additional Information:
  • Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and department of motor vehicles background checks and must meet Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) requirements post-employment.
  • Available for domestic and international travel as required.

What's in it for you:

· Well-being & Support - Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered.
· Grow with Us – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career-pathing to support internal mobility.
· People-First Culture – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve.
· Transparent Leadership – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way.

Thank you for your interest in VC3. We appreciate all applications; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
Learn more about VC3 by visiting our website and follow us on LinkedIn to stay informed!

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Who We Are

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients.

We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Your Role

As a Nurse Care Manager with Evergreen Nephrology, you are responsible for managing an assigned patient panel and addressing each patient’s specialized needs based on their individual conditions, healthcare needs, goals, and wishes. You will collaborate with a team of physicians, Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), and Interdisciplinary Team (IDT) members. Nurse Care Managers at Evergreen often focus on patients targeted for specific programs such as Chronic Complex Care Management, Compassionate Care Management, Post Acute Care, Transitions of Care, and CKD Management.

While our Nurse Care Manager positions are fully remote, this specific position will support patients in the Central and Eastern Time Zone and must be able to work 8:30a - 5p ET or CT.

Role Responsibilities

Some responsibilities may vary based on specific patient programs, but this role's primary duties include the following:

  • Managing the overall care management of patient panel by leveraging experience, expertise, and knowledge in both the nursing field and value-based care operations.
  • Establishing trusting and empathetic relationships with patients and families to provide clinical and emotional support and foster collaboration throughout their care journey.
  • Serving as an advocate and community liaison for patients to ensure proper and timely resources and support while navigating the health care system and maintaining compliance with the primary care team’s/nephrologist’s treatment plan.
  • Performing assessments and identifying the needs, including social determinants of health, of panel patients and caregivers based on values, care goals, and individual preferences, and translating these into patient-centric actionable care plans through comprehensive evaluations.
  • Coordinating the interdisciplinary approach to achieving continuity of care and reducing fragmentation, focusing on kidney disease progression management, utilization management, and provider coordination through active care plan management.
  • Monitoring and evaluating the effectiveness of care management plans regularly, modifying interventions as necessary.
  • Following evidence-based care management guidelines and established workflow protocols to deliver high quality, efficient, patient-centered care that aligns with Evergreen’s goals, quality metrics, and regulatory and payer requirements.
  • Collaborating with physician partners, community providers, APPs, and other clinical disciplines to create, implement, and manage integrated care plans.
  • Identifying cost-effective measures for patients that support value-based care goals of improving patient outcomes and quality while effectively managing resource utilization.
  • Facilitating patient and caregiver education on treatment options and empowering patients to make informed decisions about their care.
  • Supporting seamless transitions of care as patients move between care settings, proactively addressing potential barriers and collaborating with IDTs.
  • Actively participating in clinical huddles, and patient care conferences for patients under your care management as needed.
  • Engaging in continuous, organizational process improvement to identify opportunities for improvement and execute action plans to optimize care management workflows, patient engagement processes, customer/patient care efforts, and other protocols.
  • Preparing reports and other deliverables to communicate program changes or developments to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Collecting data to prepare and deliver reports alongside program leaders on program success, patient outcomes, and patient/caregiver satisfaction.
  • Other duties consistent with this role, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree in nursing
  • Current RN License is required, Compact License preferred
  • Care management experience required
  • Certified Case Manager preferred
  • Intermediate skills with MS Office Suite of products including Outlook and Teams
  • Able to work effectively in a primarily remote environment:
    • Home internet must support a minimum download speed of 25 Mbps and upload speed of 10 Mbps. Cable, Fiber, or DSL connections hardwired to the internet device are recommended
    • Evergreen will provide remote employees with telephony applications and equipment to meet the business requirements for their role
    • Employees must work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $90,000 to $103,000 annually. Exact pay is determined based on experience, education, demand for the role, and other role-specific factors.

This role is also eligible for a quarterly bonus.

Benefits

Evergreen Nephrology’s total rewards program is designed to support you in and outside of work. You can expect:

  • Paid time off starting at 4 weeks for full-time employees
  • 12 paid holidays per year
  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including an HSA with employer match
  • Reimbursement for continuing medical education for eligible roles
  • A 401(k) program where Evergreen matches up to 4% of contributions after six months of tenure
  • Paid parental leave
  • A robust training and development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career with Evergreen Nephrology

Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

We are seeking a Spanish-speaking Licensed Health Insurance Agent. This position requires a deep understanding of health insurance products, along with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and efficiently in Spanish.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

Rocket Money’s mission is to empower people to live their best financial lives. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

ABOUT THE ROLE 🤹‍♀️

Rocket Money is looking for a Senior Producer to join our Video Creative team. This isn't a traditional production role — we're looking for someone who understands direct response advertising inside and out, brings a strong creative voice, and knows how to turn raw concepts into high-performing content that entertains, educates, and converts. You'll work across digital and broadcast platforms, leading production from concept through delivery while helping us stand out in a competitive fintech space.

Your work will be part of a weekly cadence driven by data — iterating on what's working, testing what's new, and constantly pushing the limits of what drives performance and acquires users

Specifically, you will:

  • Own integrated production end-to-end — from concept through delivery, building effective direct-response ads for social media channels, digital platforms, and broadcast
  • Shoot, direct, and produce original footage — you're comfortable on set and across all stages of production from pre to post
  • Compose motion graphic explainers and source new content to scale creative output — this goes well beyond cutting and arranging pre-existing clips
  • Increase weekly output by releasing multiple variations of concepts across a wide range of sizes and formats
  • Collaborate with the creative team on ideation, storyboarding, and concept development
  • Iterate fast based on performance data — you believe data informs creativity, not limits it, and you're always optimizing for specific channels and platforms
  • Liaise with internal teams, production teams, external vendors, actors, and talent
  • Build and maintain budgets and timelines, identify and hire third-party vendors, and manage production costs
  • Continue to improve workflows for production and delivery while maintaining and contributing to asset library structure and organization
  • Format new and existing assets to properly fit all media platforms’ best practices
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously with swift turnaround times and a sharp eye for detail

  • You love producing for direct response and have a genuine instinct for how editing decisions impact the way users comprehend and respond to an ad
  • You believe data can inform creativity, not limit it
  • Able to envision and edit many different visual scenarios from a single set of raw video assets
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro and After Effects
  • Strong design sensibilities; experience with Figma and Adobe Photoshop is a plus
  • Comfortable on a production set and across all stages of production from pre to post
  • Skilled at presenting complex technical information in a clear and engaging format
  • Experienced with budgets, timelines, vendor management, and cost oversight
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to accurately assess scope and availability
  • A collaborative communicator who gives and receives feedback well and brings a fresh perspective to the table

  • Competitive Pay
  • 401k Matching

  • Learning & Development Opportunities
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Daily Lunch, Snacks & Coffee (in-office only)
