jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager / Account Manager – Client Retention & Growth

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success Manager / Account Manager to manage and strengthen relationships with existing customers, support onboarding, maintain customer satisfaction, and improve retention.

This is a client-facing role focused on relationship management, customer onboarding, account health, retention, and long-term customer value.

You’ll serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers, understand their goals, ensure they receive value from the company’s services, and proactively address concerns before they become retention risks.

If you’re a strong communicator who enjoys building lasting client relationships and taking ownership of the customer experience, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Relationship Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with clients
  • Conduct regular customer check-ins and account conversations
  • Understand each customer’s goals, priorities, and expectations
  • Maintain professional, responsive communication throughout the customer lifecycle

Customer Onboarding & Implementation

  • Support new customers through onboarding and implementation
  • Help customers understand processes, services, and next steps
  • Coordinate internally to ensure a smooth transition after the sale
  • Track onboarding progress and follow up on outstanding actions
  • Ensure customers have a strong experience from the beginning of the relationship

Customer Success & Value

  • Understand what success looks like for each customer
  • Ensure customers receive ongoing value from the company’s services
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve the customer experience
  • Conduct regular check-ins to understand satisfaction and changing needs
  • Maintain consistent engagement across assigned accounts

Retention & Risk Management

  • Identify customer concerns and potential retention risks early
  • Address issues proactively before they escalate
  • Handle difficult customer conversations professionally
  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer issues
  • Follow through until concerns are fully addressed
  • Help maintain strong customer satisfaction and retention

Account Growth

  • Identify potential upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Recognize additional customer needs during account conversations
  • Coordinate appropriate opportunities with internal teams
  • Support long-term account growth through strong customer relationships

CRM & Account Management

  • Maintain accurate customer and account records in the CRM
  • Document conversations, concerns, follow-ups, and next steps
  • Keep account information organized and current
  • Track outstanding customer requests and commitments
  • Ensure important follow-ups are completed on time

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, client services, or a related client-facing role
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • Ability to handle difficult customer conversations professionally
  • Strong organization and follow-through
  • Ability to manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously
  • Comfortable taking ownership of customer concerns through resolution
  • CRM experience preferred
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to overlap with U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts
  • Experience supporting customer onboarding or implementation
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce
  • Experience identifying upsell or cross-sell opportunities
  • Experience working with U.S.-based customers
  • Background in B2B services, SaaS, agencies, or other client-focused businesses

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Naturally build strong relationships with customers
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently
  • Proactively identify problems instead of waiting for complaints
  • Stay calm during challenging customer conversations
  • Follow through consistently on commitments
  • Care about customer satisfaction and long-term retention
  • Can balance customer needs with business priorities
  • Take ownership without requiring constant supervision

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong customer satisfaction and account relationships
  • Smooth and organized customer onboarding
  • Consistent customer communication and check-ins
  • Early identification and resolution of retention risks
  • Strong customer retention
  • Timely resolution of customer concerns

Location: Barcelona, Spain preferred, other EU locations considered

Position Overview: Senior Business Development Manager

Emergent's mission is to catalyze finance at scale to combat the climate crisis. Engaging with the private sector is a crucial part of this mission. The Senior Business Development Manager (BDM) will prospect for and convert new corporate clients of emissions reduction credits (ERs) by utilizing a variety of networking and outreach strategies. The BDM will be accountable for securing a quota of long-term ER contracts commensurate with Emergent’s goal to stop tropical deforestation.

Emergent has a rich pipeline spanning hundreds of companies – the BDM will be a key part of turning those leads into deals. They will use persuasive approaches and pitches to convince potential clients to purchase ERs through Emergent, developing rapport with new clients, setting and obtain sales targets, and providing ongoing support to continually improve customer relationships. The BDM will also grow and retain existing commercial accounts by ensuring that client stakeholders are positioned for success in terms of meeting climate targets and stakeholder requirements. In addition to prospecting and converting companies, they will support Emergent's marketing strategy, helping differentiate Emergent from competitors and accelerating decision-making and favorable commercial outcomes within its corporate prospect base.

The Senior Business Development Manager will form the core of Emergent’s sales operation in Europe and Asia and will play a key role is helping to end tropical deforestation. The ideal candidate will have experience in carbon markets, meeting corporate climate commitments in the voluntary or compliance (e.g. EU ETS) markets.

Responsibilities

Prospection and Conversion

  • Prospect and convert new corporate clients interested in emissions reduction credits through use of customer insights, network activation and commercial creativity;
  • Cold call as appropriate within prospective companies and business-focused NGO ecosystems to ensure a robust pipeline of opportunities;
  • Leverages sales tools and applied business development regimens to produce new leads, drive leads through the sales funnel, and convert prospects within accelerated timeframes;
  • Identify the decision makers and the buying journey for each prospect organization and build solid relationships with each through active listening and tailored messaging;
  • Plan each customer engagement and pitch; catalog each call in the CRM system with documented insights/actions to move prospects through the sales funnel;
  • Partner with marketing to tailor pitches that speak to prospects’ needs, concerns, and objectives;
  • Handle objections by clarifying, emphasizing agreements and working through differences; and
  • Use a variety of styles to persuade or negotiate appropriately, presenting an image that mirrors that of the client.

BD Regimen

  • Submit weekly progress reports, ensuring data is accurately entered and managed within HubSpot (CRM system);
  • Track and record activity on accounts and help to close deals to meet these targets;
  • Prepare regular reports and presentations on marketing metrics for the executive team; and
  • Preparing and reviewing monthly, quarterly, and yearly KPIs and budgets.

Strategic Planning

  • Attend industry functions, such as association events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends;
  • Present to and consult with management on business trends with a view to developing new services, products, and distribution channels;
  • Identify opportunities for campaigns, services, and distribution channels that will lead to an increase in contractual commitments; and
  • Using knowledge of the market and competitors, identify and develop Emergent’s unique selling propositions and differentiators.

Customer Research

  • Forecast sales targets based on historical offset purchases and information provided by client;
  • Develop in-depth knowledge of company offerings to identify profitable business opportunities;
  • Understand each company’s climate goals and stakeholders’ deliverables to the organization;
  • Research emerging trends and recommend new company offerings to satisfy customers’ needs; and
  • Direct marketing efforts by presenting market research to marketing leadership.

Client Retention

  • Present new products and services and enhance existing relationships;
  • Work with technical staff and other internal colleagues to meet customer needs; and
  • Arrange and participate in internal and external client debriefs.

Requirements of the Role

Essential attributes:

  • The ideal candidate has 7+ years of B2B business development experience commercializing news services, preferably in the field of sustainability;
  • Polished, highly organized and assertive B2B salesperson that roots pitches and seals deals using customer insights, networked influence and commercial creativity;
  • Regimented in her/his approach to orchestrating customer engagements and follow ups;
  • A sales hunter that leverages tools, regimen, and team work to reveal new leads and land prospects within compressed timeframes;
  • A natural leader and team player that possesses an agile approach to meeting customer needs;
  • Mastery of CRM software and digital marketing tools and channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter);
  • Strong analytical and project management skills and strategic mindset, with ability to orchestrate stakeholder decision making moments;
  • Knowledge of corporate carbon accounting and offset standards a plus;
  • Strategic in managing sales pipelines and customer engagements, yet pragmatic and agile in navigating customer objections and non-standard requests for information;
  • Understands and applies the tenets of sound project management; thrives in leading and contributing to omni-disciplined projects;
  • Deep knowledge of and experience in visualizing buyers’ journeys including decision-maker mapping and sales cycle influence points; and
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience with the contracting process.

Preferred attributes:

  • Transactions experience in carbon markets; and
  • Experience in providing financial products to corporate buyers (e.g. forward contracts).

Education and Experience:

  • Master’s degree in relevant field (MBA preferred);
  • Experience in developing existing prospect databases and mining data for insights;
  • Mastery of lead management software and the CRM process;
  • Mastery of digital and in-person events planning and delivery;
  • Skilled in the mapping of decision maker networks and individual buying journeys;
  • Mastery of successful business-to-human sales behaviours and regimen;
  • Knowledge of the customer insight generation and messaging creation processes;
  • Established chief sustainability officer and civil society/non-governmental organization networks;
  • Experience with working with or for a start-up a plus;
  • Knowledge of integrated marketing campaigns and their influence on the sales cycle;
  • Experience in carbon markets and carbon solutions a plus;
  • English fluency required; Portuguese, Spanish, French or Bahasa a plus; and
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, and Power Point) and Adobe Acrobat (or equivalent).

Applicants must have work authorization in the United Kingdom or Europe.

Emergent provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, local or other applicable laws.

Please include your cover letter and resume as a single PDF document when applying.

Forests are crucial to all life on Earth. They capture and store carbon and are one of the most promising, large-scale, and cost-effective opportunities to combat climate change. Rainforests also sustain rainfalls, food supply, vital ecosystems, and livelihoods for over a billion people. Protecting them is not just a moral imperative, it is essential for a stable, prosperous, and sustainable future for us all. As the COVID-19 crisis highlights, we live in a fragile and interconnected world where sustainability cannot be taken for granted.

There is increasing recognition of the urgency of climate change. The Paris Agreement in 2015 committed governments to keep the increase in global average temperature to well below 2 °C above pre-industrial levels. Over 1,500 major corporations have committed to climate neutrality, and over 40 countries have implemented some form of carbon pricing scheme. After two decades of putting necessary, effective, high integrity standards and market mechanisms in place, Emergent has the historic opportunity to channel this momentum to solving the deforestation crisis.

Emergent helps safeguard the world’s tropical forests by building a global market for forest carbon credits. Countries generate these credits by reducing deforestation and tropical deforestation (called “REDD+”). For forest countries, Emergent provides a guaranteed source of demand by facilitating access to a range of high-volume buyers, backed by a purchase guarantee from donors, giving countries the certainty need-ed to make investments in forest protection and chart a new course. For buyers, Emergent provides access to the highest-quality REDD+ credits, enabling them to meet their climate neutrality goals.

Now, with our customary intrepid and creative approach, and in response to years of requests, we seek to establish a virtual community of mentors outside our three flagship cities, and we seek a Program Director of Virtual Mentoring (PDVM) to help conceive of, build, and kick off our 26/27 Pilot Year.

The Program Director will serve as iMentor’s internal owner of this virtual mentoring pilot, coordinating the external partnership, corporate partner activation, mentor experience, program learning, and future growth strategy. We have important objectives with this pilot: (1) to connect more students with caring adults who can help them build the knowledge, confidence, and support networks needed to successfully navigate postsecondary education and career pathways, and (2) to activate enough corporate partners and mentors to meet participation goals, delivering a strong mentor experience, establishing effective processes with the external partner, and producing a data-informed recommendation for future scale. Reporting to iMentor’s Senior Vice President of Impact Programming, this is a role for an entrepreneurial spirit who gets fired up at the junction of innovation, data analysis, strategic outreach and recruitment, and cross functional partnership.

Volunteer Engagement & Training

Program Learning & Future Planning

We are currently seeking a Cyber Risk Consultant - Financial Services - Remote to join our team in Halifax, Toronto, Nova Scotia (CA-NS), Canada (CA).

Senior Cyber Risk Consultant – Financial Services | BISO & AI Governance

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cyber Risk Consultant to join a high-performing cybersecurity and technology risk team supporting a complex, highly regulated financial services environment. This role is ideal for a cybersecurity professional with deep expertise in cyber risk management, Business Information Security Office (BISO) operations, and emerging AI governance practices.

As a trusted advisor, you will work closely with technology, cybersecurity, and business leaders to assess cyber risks across new and existing technology initiatives, ensuring appropriate security controls, governance, and risk management practices are integrated throughout the project lifecycle. A significant focus of this role is supporting enterprise AI initiatives by evaluating the cybersecurity risks associated with Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical cybersecurity knowledge with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. You are comfortable partnering with both technical and non-technical teams, facilitating risk discussions, and providing practical, business-focused recommendations that enable innovation while maintaining a strong security posture.

This is an excellent opportunity to help shape cybersecurity governance within a rapidly evolving technology landscape while contributing to enterprise-wide AI adoption in one of the most highly regulated industries.

Key Responsibilities

Cyber Risk Management

  • Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments and technology reviews for new and existing technology initiatives.
  • Evaluate cybersecurity risks throughout the project lifecycle and provide practical risk mitigation recommendations.
  • Identify control gaps, assess residual risk, and recommend appropriate remediation strategies.

    • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
    • Cloud Security
    • Vulnerability Management
    • Cybersecurity Architecture
    • Network Security
    • Compliance
    • Security Metrics

BISO & Technology Governance

  • Support Business Information Security Office (BISO) governance processes, including technology evaluations, intake request management, and operational workflow support.
  • Manage and prioritize technology evaluation requests while helping maintain efficient governance processes.
  • Participate in cybersecurity governance activities and enterprise technology risk initiatives.

AI Governance & Emerging Technologies

  • Support the organization's AI Center of Excellence (CoE) by performing cybersecurity risk assessments for AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and other emerging technologies.
  • Evaluate AI architectures, data flows, security controls, and associated cyber risk vectors.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with enterprise cybersecurity standards, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to AI governance processes and help mature cybersecurity oversight for emerging technologies.

Third-Party & Vendor Risk

  • Assess third-party and vendor cybersecurity risks.
  • Identify security control requirements for external technology providers and recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures.

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Develop and maintain cybersecurity dashboards, metrics, reports, and executive-level management reporting.
  • Facilitate risk review sessions with technology teams, cybersecurity subject matter experts, and business stakeholders.
  • Clearly communicate complex cybersecurity and technology risk concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Build strong collaborative relationships across cybersecurity, technology, business, and executive leadership teams.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered.

Experience

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in Cybersecurity Risk Management, Information Security, Technology Risk, or Cybersecurity Governance.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience working within Financial Services, Banking, Insurance, Brokerage, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience conducting cybersecurity risk assessments, technology reviews, and control assessments.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience identifying technology risks, evaluating cybersecurity controls, identifying control gaps, and recommending risk mitigation strategies.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience across multiple cybersecurity domains, including:
    • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
    • Cloud Security
    • Vulnerability Management
    • Cybersecurity Architecture
    • Network Security
    • Compliance
    • Security Metrics
  • Minimum 5 years of experience applying cybersecurity control frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, or comparable industry standards.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience assessing cybersecurity risks related to Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI, or other emerging technologies.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience evaluating AI architectures, AI security risks, data protection considerations, and AI risk assessment methodologies.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience performing third-party or vendor cybersecurity risk assessments.
  • Minimum 3 years supporting Business Information Security Office (BISO), Technology Risk, Cyber Risk, Information Security Governance, or Enterprise Risk Management functions.
  • Minimum 3 years managing technology evaluation requests, cybersecurity intake processes, or governance workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently while delivering high-quality work within established timelines.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity risk identification, control assessments, remediation planning, risk acceptance, issue management, and risk reporting.
  • Experience evaluating cybersecurity controls across enterprise technology environments.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity governance and regulatory expectations within financial services.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.

Certifications

  • CRISC
  • CISA

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: Summary of Consultancy: IREX (International Research & Exchanges Board) is seeking proposals from qualified individuals to provide curriculum, competency-based education and training, and work-based learning expertise for the anticipated Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC)-funded TVET Technical Support Consultancy in Belize.
jobs.description:
Summary of Consultancy:
IREX (International Research & Exchanges Board) is seeking proposals from qualified individuals to provide curriculum, competency-based education and training, and work-based learning expertise for the anticipated Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC)-funded TVET Technical Support Consultancy in Belize. The consultancy will support MCA-Belize and the Government of Belize in designing and implementing the Training and Transitioning to Work Activity, which aims to strengthen the governance, quality, and labour-market relevance of Belize’s TVET system and improve learners’ transition from training into employment.

The Curriculum, CBET and WBL Consultant responsibilities will include supporting the design, adaptation, and quality assurance of competency-based TVET curricula; developing practical tools and guidance for competency-based education and training; and designing work-based learning models that connect training providers, employers, and learners. The consultant will work closely with IREX technical staff, MCA-Belize, Sector Skills Councils, TVET providers, and employer partners to ensure that curriculum and WBL approaches are employer-responsive and aligned with national and regional qualifications frameworks. The consultancy is expected to take place from early 2027 to mid-2028, subject to award and funding. Periodic travel to Belize will be required.

** This consultancy is contingent upon funding**
IREX reserves the right to withdraw this request for proposals at any time up to the award of the contract.

Proposal Requirements
Individuals interested in furnishing this service must submit a CV which demonstrates the consultant's experience and capacity to:
  • Facilitate participatory curriculum co-design processes with TVET instructors, private sector experts, Sector Skills Councils, and other stakeholders.
  • Develop, adapt, and quality assure competency-based TVET curricula aligned with occupational standards, employer requirements, and national or regional qualifications frameworks.
  • Design practical tools, templates, and guidance for competency-based education and training, including learning outcomes, assessment methods, modular course structures, and trainer-facing materials.
  • Design and facilitate TVET instructor and leadership professional development.
  • Develop work-based learning models, guidelines, and implementation tools for internships, apprenticeships, industry attachments, project-based learning, and other workplace training modalities.
  • Support training provider and employer readiness for WBL, including trainee preparation, workplace supervision, safeguarding, assessment, feedback, and placement tracking.

The ideal consultant will possess the following qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in education, TVET, curriculum development, workforce development, instructional design, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum seven years of progressively responsible experience in TVET curriculum development, competency-based education and training, workforce development, or related technical assistance.
  • Demonstrated expertise in CBET curriculum design, occupational standards, modular and stackable credentials, assessment design, and alignment of training programs with employer-defined competencies.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or strengthening work-based learning systems, including internships, apprenticeships, industry attachments, workplace projects, employer supervision, and learner transition support.
  • Experience working with TVET providers, ministries, qualification authorities, sector skills councils, employers, or industry associations to improve training quality and labour-market relevance.
  • Demonstrated understanding of adult learning principles, inclusive training design, and practical approaches for supporting diverse learners, instructors, and institutions.
  • Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder consultations, validation sessions, training-of-trainers, or co-design processes with public, private, and civil society stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to produce clear, professional written deliverables in English.
  • Experience working constructively as part of a multidisciplinary team, including in virtual or hybrid settings.
  • Knowledge of Caribbean Vocational Qualifications, regional qualifications frameworks, competency standards, accreditation, or quality assurance systems relevant to TVET is preferred
  • Professional experience in Belize and/or the Caribbean region is preferred; proficiency in Spanish is an asset.
IREX may at its discretion ask for additional information, including references. Issuing this call does not commit IREX to select any applicant/expert. IREX may select more than one candidate from this call.

Proposal Submission Requirements
If you are interested in providing this service, please submit a CV to this application that includes your daily rate requirements, no later than 5:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on September 11, 2026. Late submissions will only be considered if in the best interests of the project, and then at IREX’s sole discretion.
All proposals submitted must be valid for a period of not less than sixty (60) calendar days from the closing date indicated above.

Candidate Evaluation
The criteria are listed in descending order starting with the most important factors to be evaluated.
Previous experience (65%)
Qualifications (15%)
Cost (20%)

Renewal
IREX reserves the right, based on availability of funding and vendor performance, to enter into subsequent contractual agreements with the winning vendor for a period of up to three years without issuing a new RFP.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing Manager to lead and scale the company’s B2B marketing strategy across the entire customer journey.

This is not a coordinator role.

You’ll own the complete marketing engine—from generating demand and building brand awareness to optimizing conversion funnels and driving measurable revenue growth.

You’ll work across:

  • Demand generation
  • Paid advertising
  • SEO
  • Social media
  • Email marketing
  • Outbound campaigns
  • Partnerships
  • Marketing analytics

This is a high-ownership role for a strategic marketer who enjoys building marketing systems while remaining hands-on with campaign execution and optimization.

If you’re passionate about growth, performance marketing, and turning marketing into measurable business results, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive B2B marketing strategy aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Own the full marketing funnel, from awareness through customer acquisition and retention.
  • Partner closely with leadership and sales to drive pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Build, mentor, and manage internal marketing resources and external contractors.
  • Identify opportunities to improve acquisition, conversion, retention, and customer lifetime value.

Multi-Channel Campaign Management

Lead and optimize campaigns across:

  • Google Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • Meta Ads
  • SEO
  • Email Marketing
  • Outbound Campaigns
  • Partnerships & Collaborations

You will:

  • Manage campaign budgets to maximize ROI.
  • Oversee messaging, positioning, and creative direction.
  • Ensure consistent branding across every customer touchpoint.
  • Continuously optimize campaign performance.

Demand Generation & Growth

  • Launch campaigns that generate qualified leads and pipeline.
  • Build scalable lead-generation systems.
  • Improve landing pages and conversion funnels.
  • Execute A/B testing across ads, emails, landing pages, and messaging.
  • Collaborate with content, design, sales, and technical teams to execute growth initiatives.
  • Continuously test new acquisition channels and marketing strategies.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

Track and optimize key marketing metrics, including:

  • Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)
  • Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)
  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Marketing ROI
  • Website Traffic
  • Conversion Rates
  • Lead-to-Opportunity Conversion

You will:

  • Build dashboards and executive reports.
  • Present actionable insights and recommendations to leadership.
  • Make data-driven decisions that improve marketing performance.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, growth marketing, or digital marketing leadership.
  • Experience leading marketing initiatives in roles such as:
    • Digital Marketing Manager
    • Senior Marketing Manager
    • Growth Marketing Manager
    • Growth Lead
    • Head of Marketing

Technical Skills

Proven experience managing:

  • Google Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • Meta Ads
  • SEO
  • Email Marketing
  • Demand Generation
  • Outbound Marketing

Strong experience with:

  • HubSpot
  • Marketing automation platforms
  • CRM systems
  • Marketing analytics and reporting tools

Strong understanding of:

  • B2B marketing funnels
  • Lead generation
  • Performance marketing
  • Conversion optimization
  • Marketing attribution

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM).
  • Experience marketing B2B services or professional services.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Salesforce
    • Marketo
    • Outreach
  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or cross-functional marketing teams.
  • Strong brand positioning and storytelling experience.

Tools & Platforms

  • Google Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • Meta Ads
  • HubSpot
  • Google Analytics 4
  • CRM & Marketing Automation Platforms
  • SEO Tools
  • Reporting & Analytics Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strategic thinker who enjoys executing campaigns.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
  • Comfortable owning the entire marketing function.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communicator and cross-functional collaborator.
  • Curious, data-driven, and committed to continuous optimization.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign dashboards and marketing KPIs.
  • Optimize paid campaigns and lead-generation funnels.
  • Collaborate with sales and leadership on growth priorities.
  • Launch and monitor campaigns across paid and organic channels.
  • Analyze conversion rates, CAC, and pipeline performance.
  • Test new messaging, audiences, and acquisition channels.
  • Present performance insights and strategic recommendations.

In short: You own the company’s growth engine—building marketing systems that generate pipeline, strengthen the brand, and drive measurable revenue growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Growth in Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)
  • Growth in Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)
  • Reduced Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Improved Marketing ROI
  • Increased website traffic and conversion rates
  • Strong lead-to-opportunity conversion
  • Marketing contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Increased brand visibility and engagement

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Own the complete B2B marketing function.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership on growth strategy.
  • End-to-end ownership of demand generation and pipeline growth.
  • Blend strategic leadership with hands-on execution.
  • Fully remote environment with significant autonomy.
  • Clear career progression into:
    • Head of Marketing
    • Director of Marketing
    • VP of Marketing
    • Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Initial Interview
  4. Technical & Strategic Marketing Interview
  5. Final Interview with Leadership
  6. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a growth-focused B2B marketer who enjoys building demand generation systems, optimizing marketing performance, and driving measurable business growth, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the next stage of growth for an ambitious, fast-moving organization.

jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Solutions Engineer – Agents & Automation is responsible for building and delivering enterprise agent solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder. This role also supports agent governance and lifecycle management through Agent 365.

This role focuses on hands-on implementation of declarative and prompt-based agents, custom-engine agents, and enterprise integrations, while helping customers establish governed, scalable environments for agent development and lifecycle management. Responsibilities include configuring Power Platform environment strategy, implementing zoned governance, developing agents across Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry, and supporting secure agent operations across Power Platform and Azure. The role also includes Agent 365 onboarding activities such as configuring conditional access policies, enabling agent lifecycle workflows, and implementing key governance and security capabilities across the Microsoft 365 admin center, Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft Defender.

The Solutions Engineer translates designs into production-ready solutions, drives consistent and secure delivery, and accelerates reuse through proven patterns. This is a hands-on role focused on applied AI and agent-based automation, helping organizations establish scalable, governed agent capabilities within SHI’s Microsoft Services practice. It sits at the intersection of AI innovation, human experience, and responsible AI enablement, offering the opportunity to shape how organizations build lasting capability with Microsoft agents while contributing to the evolution of SHI’s Microsoft Services practice.

Role Description

Agent Architecture and Development Experience

  • Act as the technical SME for workforce agent solution development across Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry, including first-party agents, declarative agents, and custom-engine agent development.

  • Build and deploy custom-engine agents in Microsoft Foundry, including model selection, orchestration, grounding, evaluation, tool and function integration, and connectivity with Copilot Studio and enterprise systems.

  • Demonstrate familiarity with the Microsoft IQ stack, including Work IQ, Foundry IQ, and Fabric IQ, and its role in enabling intelligent agent experiences, including knowledge, grounding, orchestration, evaluation, and integration patterns across Microsoft agent platforms.

  • Guide SHI customers with hands-on agent solution delivery, custom DLP policies, environment and AI readiness assessment, use case identification, and governance of enterprise agent platforms.

  • Lead agent governance implementation: environment readiness, Power Platform environment strategy, zoned governance, prerequisite validation, platform enablement, and deployment planning across Power Platform, Azure, and related services, using Power Platform Pipelines, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions where appropriate.

  • Design and implement agent security and compliance controls as part of Agent 365 onboarding, using Microsoft Purview for labels, DLP, and eDiscovery; Microsoft Defender for threat visibility; and Microsoft Entra Agent ID for identity, conditional access, and least-privilege access.

  • Establish enterprise agent governance with environment strategy (DEV/UAT/PROD), managed environments, ALM/pipelines, connector governance, solution packaging, auditing, and lifecycle management for Copilot Studio agents and agent flows.

  • Own the end-to-end implementation of agent solutions by translating business requirements into workflows, automations, integrations, and extensibility patterns across Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services, and Power Platform.

  • Implement Power Platform governance and ALM capabilities, including managed environments, environment groups, DLP policies, pipeline configuration, approval workflows, Copilot Studio Kit setup, and administrator enablement.

  • Define fit-for-purpose agent architectures that align platform capabilities, custom agent logic, integrations, orchestration patterns, and automation workflows to customer requirements.

  • Implement secure and governed agent environments, including identity, data access, compliance, monitoring, and lifecycle management using Microsoft security and governance services.

  • Guide teams on agent design, governance, evaluation, observability, audit readiness, and operational best practices, including analytics, feedback loops, and continuous improvement.

  • Develop and maintain reusable technical assets, including reference architectures, design patterns, solution templates, and implementation guides for Copilot and agent services.

  • Help customers evaluate and adopt emerging Microsoft’s Frontier agent capabilities, including prebuilt Microsoft agents, Microsoft Foundry features, Copilot Studio capabilities, and new Agent 365 platform services.

  • Apply FinOps practices for agents and AI workloads, including Copilot Credit planning, cost-benefit analysis, usage forecasting, model selection, consumption monitoring, and cost optimization across Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and related Microsoft AI services.

  • Work effectively in Visual Studio Code and use GitHub Copilot and other coding assistants to build, extend, and troubleshoot solutions for Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry-hosted agents, and the Agent 365 SDK.

  • Demonstrate familiarity with agent development frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework to support extensible, code-first agent development patterns across Microsoft agent platforms.

  • Perform agent evaluations in Microsoft Foundry and Copilot Studio, including testing agent responses, validating grounding quality, measuring effectiveness, and using evaluation results to improve agent behavior, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design agent grounding and retrieval architectures using enterprise data sources, connectors, knowledge sources, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Graph, MCP Servers, Dataverse, and secure data access patterns.

  • Implement responsible AI and safety controls for agent solutions, including safety testing, evaluation criteria, risk review, content moderation considerations, human oversight patterns, and continuous improvement.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Customer Communication: Clearly explain complex Microsoft AI, Copilot, agent, governance, and automation concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Presentation and Facilitation: Design and deliver engaging presentations, workshops, and technical discussions that are tailored to the audience, business need, and delivery context.

  • Technical Judgment: Evaluate requirements, constraints, risks, and platform capabilities to recommend practical, scalable, and supportable agent solutions.

  • Problem Solving: Proactively identify issues, dependencies, and delivery risks, then recommend clear options and corrective actions.

  • Detail Orientation: Manage complex implementation tasks with attention to configuration accuracy, governance requirements, documentation quality, and delivery consistency.

  • Organization and Follow-Through: Coordinate multiple workstreams, track decisions and action items, and ensure commitments are completed on time.

  • Relationship Building: Build trust with customers, partners, Microsoft stakeholders, and internal delivery teams through reliable communication and collaborative execution.

  • Documentation and Reuse: Create clear documentation, implementation guides, design patterns, and reusable assets that improve delivery quality and operational efficiency.

  • Results Orientation: Drive work to measurable outcomes, balancing customer value, technical quality, governance, and long-term supportability.

Skill Level Requirements

We are looking for candidates who demonstrate strength across the following areas. Deep expertise in every tool is not required, but experience across these capabilities is important for success. Candidates should not self-select out if they do not meet all of these.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Four or more years of experience delivering solutions on Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure, or related Microsoft cloud technologies, including hands-on experience with AI or agent-based solutions.

  • Practical experience developing production agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry, including first-party agent capabilities and custom-engine agents.

  • Experience designing or implementing declarative and embedded agent experiences across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Fx, and configuration-based development patterns such as YAML.

  • Strong understanding of agent architecture, governance, security, and lifecycle management, including identity, compliance, monitoring, and operational controls across Power Platform Admin Center, Microsoft 365 admin center, Agent 365 control plane, Foundry control plane, and related services.

  • Proven ability to act as a technical advisor and SME, guiding solution design and implementation decisions across project teams.

  • Working knowledge of applied AI concepts, including prompt design, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.

  • Familiarity with design-led or human-centered approaches as they apply to technical solution design and workflow modeling.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Relevant certifications may include Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals (AB-900), Power Platform Solutions Architect (PL-600), Microsoft Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect (AB-100), Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-103), or equivalent experience.

Candidates are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet all listed qualifications.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to travel to SHI, Partner, and Customer events.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales, delivery, engineering, and leadership stakeholders.

  • Commitment to continuous learning and upskilling across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Foundry, Agent 365, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, AI workloads, governance, and change and adoption best practices.

  • Strong ethical standards with disciplined adherence to data privacy, governance, compliance, and security policies.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $150,000 - $200,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

  • Comfortable communicating and selling to U.S.-based customers

  • Results-oriented and comfortable working toward sales targets
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Willing and able to obtain the appropriate Texas insurance license, if not already licensed

  • Ability and willingness to travel to Houston, Texas for initial training

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Texas General Lines – Property and Casualty license

  • Previous experience selling insurance directly to customers in the United States

You are an experienced insurance salesperson who knows how to build trust, identify customer needs, and close business.

This role offers the opportunity to combine your insurance expertise, English proficiency, and sales ability while working remotely from Latin America for the U.S. market.

Job Description

ABOUT STRIDE

For 25 years, Stride, Inc. (NYSE: LRN) has been reimagining what education can look like outside the traditional classroom. Through K12 and our family of brands, we provide personalized K-12, career, and lifelong learning to millions of students nationwide, wherever they are. We're a fully remote company, and our mission is simple: help every learner reach their full potential through inspired teaching and personalized learning.

ABOUT THE CORPORATE COMMUNICATIONS TEAM

The Corporate Communications team supports Stride's enterprise communications across K12 and every brand in our portfolio, spanning internal communications, digital communications, local and national media relations, and reputation management. The team is organized into three pods: the Media Pod, the Channels Pod, and the Enablement Pod.

SUMMARY

The Communications Senior Manager works across all three pods to drive the team's priority projects, keep the roadmap moving, and make sure our media, brand, and executive communications work is coordinated rather than duplicated. This role has significant hands-on accountability for media and PR execution, and steps in as the senior communications decision-maker when the Senior Director is unavailable.

This is a high-visibility role for a communications professional who has built a career across the full breadth of corporate communications, internal and external alike: pitching and placing national media, leading internal and digital communications, shaping brand and reputation strategy, leading through a crisis, and preparing executives to communicate under pressure. We're looking for someone who has done this work directly, not just directed others doing it, and who is ready to lead across pods, people, and priorities without needing formal authority to do it.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

You understand every function this team runs. You are as fluent in internal communications and digital and channel strategy as you are in national media and PR, and you can move across all of it credibly.

You are a strategic communicator with strong media instincts and the ability to translate organizational priorities into compelling, coordinated communications programs.

You understand how stories travel across national, consumer, and education media, and you know how to shape them proactively and respond to them quickly.

You have a track record of building and leading large-scale, data-driven media programs, and you can point to the results, not just the activity.

You understand how PR and earned media are shaping AI, not just how AI is changing PR. You know how coverage, reputation, and content feed into what generative search and AI tools say about an organization, and you bring a clear point of view and a plan of action on that shift, not just awareness of it.

You build structure. You manage multiple high-priority workstreams with discipline, keep cross-functional projects on track, and surface risks before they become problems.

You are comfortable in high-pressure situations, including crisis response and executive-level communications, and you bring a calm, solutions-oriented approach to whatever comes at you.

You lead with influence. You don't need a direct reporting line to set direction, hold people accountable, and bring out the best in the people you work with.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7-10+ years of corporate communications experience spanning national media strategy, internal communications, brand and reputation, executive communications, and crisis communications
  • Working knowledge of how PR and earned media influence AI-driven search, summaries, and generative platforms, and a clear point of view on how that is reshaping brand visibility and reputation
  • Experience in K-12, higher education, or another highly regulated, mission-driven consumer sector strongly preferred
  • Experience at a publicly traded company a plus
  • Demonstrated success designing and leading large scale media programs, with the ability to speak to measurable outcomes such as share of voice, message pull-through, and reputation metrics
  • Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional or matrixed teams
  • Experience developing and coaching communications talent
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree a plus
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.
  • Ability to clear required background check.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Cross-Pod Strategy and Roadmap Leadership

  • Own and drive the Corporate Communications roadmap, working across the Media, Channels, and Enablement pods to keep priority projects and campaigns moving
  • Partner with pod leads on annual planning, campaign calendars, and cross-functional initiatives

Media and Brand Strategy

  • Shape national media and brand strategy that elevates Stride and our schools across education, consumer, and trade media
  • Guide how the team builds reputation across earned media, owned channels, and emerging surfaces like AI and generative search
  • Prepare executives and subject matter experts to be credible, confident spokespeople

Crisis and Issues Communications

  • Lead crisis and issues communications planning, response, and recovery in partnership with the Senior Director
  • Serve as the senior communications decision-maker during crisis situations when the Senior Director is unavailable

Team and Agency Leadership

  • Lead without direct authority: set direction for pod members on cross-team initiatives, hold people accountable to deadlines and quality, and develop the team's capability along the way
  • Manage external PR agencies and consultants to ensure their work aligns with strategy and delivers measurable impact

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have direct reports.

Reddit is poised to innovate and grow like never before, and Safety is a critical accelerant of that growth. The Safety org is Reddit’s central Trust & Safety organization, protecting users from bad experiences by stopping harmful content, behaviors, and abuse across the platform. We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead ads fraud detection and scaled enforcement within Safety. You will partner closely with Ads Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Operations, Policy, Legal, and fellow Safety data scientists to identify emerging ads fraud, define rigorous measurement and evaluation standards, and turn investigations into durable signals, models, rules, and enforcement pipelines. This is a high-impact role with exceptional opportunity for ownership and growth: as an early leader in a greenfield space, you will help define the strategy, shape cross-functional roadmaps, build foundational capabilities, and expand your scope as Reddit’s ads integrity program matures.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the measurement and detection strategy for ads fraud by defining fraud taxonomies, labels, sampling plans, metrics, and evaluation frameworks that make performance measurable and defensible.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets and networks of behavior to uncover emerging fraud patterns, size their impact, identify root causes, and translate findings into detection and enforcement requirements.
  • Design and develop scalable ads fraud detection and enforcement pipelines in partnership with Engineering and Machine Learning, including feature generation, rules and models, near-real-time scoring, actioning, review feedback loops, and observability.
  • Own the full detection lifecycle: backtesting, threshold calibration, offline and online evaluation, launch validation, experimentation, monitoring, drift detection, incident response, rollback, and retirement.
  • Build and maintain statistical, machine learning, and GenAI-enabled models or prototypes that improve fraud detection, risk identification, investigator efficiency, and enforcement quality.
  • Balance fraud loss, platform and advertiser risk, customer experience, false-positive costs, operational capacity, and business goals when recommending detection thresholds and enforcement strategies.
  • Partner across Ads and Safety to shape strategy and roadmaps, strengthen data foundations, close policy and enforcement gaps, and ensure solutions meet governance and compliance standards.
  • Translate complex analyses into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders, and mentor other data scientists and analysts.

Qualifications

  • Relevant experience in Data Science, Applied Science, or a related quantitative role, preferably in ads fraud, financial fraud, or account risk, Trust & Safety, platform integrity, or enforcement engineering.
  • Ph.D. or M.S. degree in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or another quantitative field; with an M.S., 4+ years of industry data science experience, or with a Ph.D., 2+ years of industry data science experience.
  • Demonstrated experience building or materially shaping production detection and automated enforcement pipelines, including batch or streaming data, feature engineering, rules or models, decisioning, monitoring, and feedback loops.
  • Strong command of fraud or abuse detection methods and evaluation, including label design, precision and recall tradeoffs, calibration, threshold selection, false-positive analysis, drift detection, and adversarial adaptation.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams to translate analyses and prototypes into reliable production systems; experience working across Ads, Safety, fraud, risk, or platform-integrity organizations is preferred.
  • Experience applying AI and large language models (LLMs) to practical data science workflows, such as threat discovery, content classification, signal development, investigation automation, or detection and enforcement systems.
  • Deep understanding of complex behavioral networks or large-scale activity patterns; experience with methods such as graph or network analysis, clustering, anomaly detection, or natural language processing is valuable.
  • Fluency in statistical analysis, Python or a similar programming language, and SQL, with the ability to work independently across complex data systems and unfamiliar codebases.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguously defined problems, deconstruct them into precise and tractable components, and move from investigation to scalable, reusable solutions.

jobs.description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Matt W, VP of Product & Design at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Principal Product Designer. Principal Product Designer is the highest individual contributor design role at Customer.io. This person shapes the design vision for the company and influences how design is practiced here — through their own craft, through the standards their work sets, and through the partnerships they build with product and engineering leadership.

Customer.io is in a transformational moment: executing against a strong current product while redesigning what the product is and how it's experienced by a new generation of builders. This role has to straddle both — delivering quality and coherence in what exists today while driving the vision for where things go.

This is not a management role, but it's a leadership role in the fullest sense. Their influence is felt company-wide — in the product, in the culture, and in who we hire.

About you

You have a fully formed point of view on how AI changes what software means — for the people who use it, the people who build it, and the agents that increasingly operate it. You have the conviction to put that view to work across a product and an organization. You lead through clarity and example, give candid feedback that improves the work, and operate with humility and curiosity even outside your own expertise.

What we value

  • Leads through clarity and example, not control. You shape culture through your own practice — not top-down direction.
  • Candid craft feedback. You give feedback that improves the work, even when it's uncomfortable.
  • Humility and curiosity. You operate with openness, especially in areas outside your expertise.
  • Amplifying others. You raise the impact of people across the whole company — not just the design team.
  • Bias for craft. You stay close to the work by choice, and that proximity is how you lead.

Some things you'll do

  • Shape and communicate a design vision for Customer.io's product as a whole — the coherent, long-range picture of what excellent looks like for our customers, brought into rooms where product direction gets set
  • Drive the strategic direction of Pluma, our design system — architecture, evolution, deprecation decisions, and the principles that govern how it scales
  • Close the gap between design intent and shipped product — stay close enough to implementation to catch divergence, and fix it directly when code is the right tool
  • Design for builder and developer audiences — CLI-native flows, API-first onboarding, and interfaces built for people who type before they click
  • Lead the design of agentic and human-AI surfaces across the product — develop the philosophy and advocate for the standards
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership on product strategy — bring design into the conversation before direction is set, not after
  • Develop and advocate for Customer.io's AI product design philosophy as a framework the whole team builds from
  • Lead design review for major initiatives and bring accountability for quality and coherence across what ships
  • Develop Staff designers through direct mentorship, critique, and the clarity of your own example
  • Contribute to hiring and calibration — assess candidates with conviction and help the team develop a shared language for what excellent looks like

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years of product design experience with a portfolio demonstrating design vision and organizational impact, not just individual craft
  • Track record of shaping design direction at the company level — influenced what gets built and why, not just how it looks
  • Designed for developer and builder audiences — CLI, API-first onboarding, or infrastructure-native products
  • Developed point of view on AI and agentic product design — has shipped AI-native interfaces and can articulate a philosophy on interaction models for agentic and delegated use
  • Contributed to a design system at the strategic level — shaped what it should be and shouldn't be, and advocated for those decisions over time
  • Operates with influence without authority — track record of aligning product, engineering, and exec leadership around a design direction without a management title
  • Has raised the craft bar at an organizational level — through critique culture, standards, and the example others internalize
  • Executive-level communication — connects design decisions to customer impact, product differentiation, and business outcomes
  • B2B SaaS depth — understands complex, data-heavy products and has opinions about where the interaction model breaks

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. The starting salary for this role is $245k-$276k USD, depending on experience and subject to market-rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks of paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions — just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • 30 minute call with Recruiter
  • 45 minute call and portfolio review with Hiring Manager
  • 30 minute call with cross-functional partner
  • 60 minute design case call with members of the design & tech team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions, please contact .

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

ServiceTitan strives to be the best place our Titans have ever worked, so they can do the best work they’ve ever done. The Experience Design (XD) team is central to this mission. We solve real world problems in the home services industry. We are passionate about bringing innovative and delightful solutions to traditional problems and workflows. Our ambitious team of product designers works closely with product managers, engineers, product marketers and with thousands of our users to help make their lives easier through technology. We embrace agile development and design thinking to ship dozens of new features every month. We measure our success based on our customer’s success. We strive for real impact.

We are looking for a hands-on Group Manager, Product Design Back office who enjoys solving complex problems with data-driven solutions. You bring a balanced toolkit of research, interface design, and prototyping capabilities — and the leadership chops to build and grow a high-performing team. You go deep into the details and step back to connect the dots strategically. You thrive in ambiguity, come with a strong point of view, and bring the rigor that helps your team make good decisions quickly. You bring a modern design practice — one that embraces AI as a creative and strategic accelerator, not just a productivity shortcut.

What you'll do:

  • Hire, train, and mentor a high-performing team to execute our product vision and strategy with measurable business impact

  • Lead design projects of significant scope across vision, strategy, and execution

  • Build lean standards and processes that balance quality, capability, and speed

  • Contribute to product strategy and roadmaps in service of company objectives

  • Use AI tools fluently — from rapid prototyping and generative exploration to shipping faster, higher-quality work

  • Partner effectively with teams in the US and across time zones, bringing strong async communication and a collaborative, low-ego working style

  • Build relationships across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Data Science to deliver cohesive, inclusive user experiences

  • Own key UX artifacts — user journeys, personas, UX measurement, and more

  • Drive accessibility through inclusive design, awareness, and innovation

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in a SaaS or enterprise environment

  • Experience leading and managing a 3–10 person design team or groups of teams

  • Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted design tools (e.g. Figma Make, Claude, Cursor, or similar) and a curiosity to keep evolving your practice as the tooling does.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality design output at scale, measured through both quantitative and qualitative methods

  • A strong coach and leader — direct with feedback, dedicated to your team's growth, and able to foster healthy design culture across the org

  • Strong communicator and collaborator across multi-disciplinary, globally distributed teams with the ability to manage senior stakeholder expectations

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $20–$35 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a Founders Associate internship working directly with the founders on whatever matters most that week. The work moves between strategy, analysis, and execution: scoping a question nobody has answered yet, doing the research, forming a recommendation, and then owning the follow-through until it is actually done. You will see how an early-stage company gets built from the inside, including the parts that are unglamorous and still undecided.

Because the team is small, the projects are real and the ownership is genuine. Expect limited structure, frequent context switching, and a high bar on written communication, since most decisions here are made from a well-argued document rather than a meeting.

Responsibilities

  • Own discrete, high-impact projects end to end for the founders, from framing the question through to the recommendation and the follow-through.
  • Research markets, competitors, customers, and internal data, and turn findings into clear written recommendations.
  • Move between strategy, analysis, and hands-on execution depending on what the week requires.
  • Build lightweight process and documentation where none exists, so the same work does not have to be redone.
  • Track commitments across the team and make sure decisions turn into action.

Requirements

  • Strong judgment, organization, and follow-through on work with limited supervision.
  • Excellent written communication, including the ability to synthesize a messy problem into a clear argument.
  • Strong research skills across both public sources and internal data.
  • Comfort switching between strategy, analysis, and execution.
  • Ability to work on ambiguous projects with limited structure.
  • High ownership mindset and self-direction in a remote startup environment.

Being a Lead on the team, expect full autonomy to deliver results.

30 vs 60 vs 90 Day Onboarding Plan

  • 30 days: meet with your key stakeholders, collaborate with our Recruiting Team, understand headcount demand, navigate our systems, kickoff searches, run interviews and workshop your Coalition pitch
  • 60 days: get your 1st candidate to offer, juggle concurrent searches, zero-in on ideal talent profiles, perfect your sourcing rhythm and build agents to automate work
  • 90 days: running with full autonomy, closed a couple roles, own headcount strategy, developing trust with stakeholders and taking on more responsibility outside core recruitment workflows

  • Partner with leaders to understand business priorities, define candidate profiles, establish clear success criteria, and create structured, efficient interview plans.
  • Use tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, Juicebox, Greenhouse, Glean, and other relevant tools to find great people and improve workflows.
  • Deliver clear, compelling storytelling about Coalition’s mission, products, technical challenges, and opportunities for impact to candidates with varied backgrounds and levels of experience.
  • Lead offer processes for complex technical and functional hires, including compensation alignment, offer strategy, negotiation, closing, and transition to onboarding.
  • Use recruiting metrics and reporting to evaluate pipeline health, sourcing effectiveness, funnel conversion, candidate quality, time in process, and hiring-manager engagement.

  • Experience using recruiting metrics and reporting to diagnose funnel performance, improve pipeline quality, and strengthen hiring outcomes.
  • Clear, compelling communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage candidates and stakeholders across technical and nontechnical audiences.

Bonus Points

  • Experience hiring across a range of seniority levels, from experienced individual contributors through senior leadership.
  • Background recruiting for remote or distributed teams across the United States and Canada.
  • Experience supporting early-stage or scaling companies where each hire is closely tied to company-level priorities and outcomes.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity, insurance, risk management, SaaS, or other complex technical and regulated industries.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $160,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $190,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >
