Principal System & AI Safety Engineer

Help reinvent how the world assures autonomous and AI-enabled systems.

About Edge Case:

At Edge Case, our mission is to enable the safe deployment of frontier technologies and sophisticated systems.

Edge Case exists to solve one of technology's most consequential problems: deploying autonomous, AI-enabled,and complex systems without compromising safety.

Our team includes recognized leaders in autonomous-system safety. Across defense, aerospace, automotive,energy, and other high-consequence industries, we help organizations move frontier technologies from promising prototypes to trusted real-world systems.

Guardian AI is our AI-assisted safety intelligence platform. It combines modern software with expert judgment to help teams identify hazards earlier, develop stronger safety arguments, and maintain decision-ready safety evidence.

The Opportunity:

This is not a conventional compliance role.

We are looking for a system safety thought leader and entrepreneurial builder who wants to solve problems that no single engagement or engineering team could address alone.

You will apply Guardian AI to complex customer programs, identify repeatable problems, invent better methods, and work directly with our product team to turn expert knowledge into scalable capabilities. You will help define the emerging discipline of AI-assisted safety engineering while influencing the product, company, and broader field.

This role is ideal for someone who combines deep technical credibility with entrepreneurial energy: someone who sees an unsolved problem and wants to build the method, workflow, and product that solves it.

What You'll Own:

Solve high-consequence safety problems

  • Lead system safety work for autonomous and complex systems. Help customers reason through novel hazards, operational uncertainty, and increasingly software- and AI-driven behavior.

Pioneer AI-assisted safety engineering

  • Use Guardian AI to accelerate and strengthen analyses such as PHA, FHA, SHA, FTA, FMECA, STPA, and HARA.
  • Determine where AI improves engineering performance and where expert judgment must remain decisive.

Set the technical bar

  • Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for rigor, traceability, completeness, and alignment with applicable standards.
  • Establish validation practices customers can trust in safety-critical environments.

Turn expertise into product

  • Recognize recurring customer problems, prototype better workflows, and partner with our software team to transform those insights into Guardian AI capabilities.

Shape safety architectures and requirements

  • Advise customers on CONOPS, ODDs, hazard controls, system and subsystem safety requirements, levels of rigor, mitigations, and verification strategies.

Advance digital safety cases

  • Help organizations move from static documents to connected, maintainable digital safety cases and decision-ready safety evidence.

Help move the field forward

  • Develop technical viewpoints and, where appropriate, contribute to publications, standards, conferences, and senior industry conversations.

Elevate the team

  • Mentor engineers, challenge assumptions, share emerging research, and strengthen a culture of rigor, experimentation, and high ownership.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers solve safety problems that previously seemed too complex, expensive, or time-consuming.
  • Recurring engineering challenges become reusable Guardian AI workflows and product capabilities.
  • AI-assisted workflows improve speed and insight without weakening rigor, traceability, or human accountability.
  • Edge Case becomes increasingly recognized as a leader in next-generation system safety.


Required Qualifications:

  • A strong record of accomplishment in system safety through high-consequence programs, influential research,
  • technical leadership, or a combination of these.
  • Expertise in methods such as PHA, FHA, SHA, FTA, FMECA, STPA, HARA, or related approaches.
  • Experience with frameworks such as MIL-STD-882E, JSSSEH, ISO 26262, ISO 21448/SOTIF, ARP4761, or
  • DO-178C.
  • Experience developing safety requirements, plans, cases, assessment reports, or comparable assurance
  • artifacts.
  • Ability to move between detailed analysis, system architecture, customer strategy, and Product design.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A builder's mindset: initiative, curiosity, comfort with ambiguity, and a desire to create repeatable solutions.
  • Enthusiasm for AI and automation, paired with sound judgment about their limitations.
  • U.S. work authorization. Employment sponsorship is not available.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD preferred in system safety, systems engineering, robotics, controls, computer science, AI/ML, human factors, or a related field. Exceptional equivalent experience is welcomed.
  • Recognized contributions through research, publications, patents, standards, conference presentations, or industry leadership.
  • Experience with autonomous systems, ML safety, AI assurance, behavioral safety, or adaptive systems.
  • Startup, product, advanced research, or zero-to-one development experience.
  • Familiarity with digital engineering, MBSE, Cameo, or digital safety cases.
  • Experience working directly with software product and engineering teams.
  • CSP, CFSE, CFSP, or a related certification.

Why Edge Case?

  • Work on a defining problem: Help society realize the benefits of autonomous and AI-enabled systems without accepting unmanaged risk.
  • Create impact at scale: Shape a platform used across customers, programs, and industries - not just one system.
  • Build, don't just advise: Develop the product capabilities and methods that solve the problems you identify.
  • Influence the direction: Work closely with company leaders, customers, and the Guardian AI product team.
  • Stay at the intellectual frontier: Engage with unresolved questions in autonomy, AI assurance, digital engineering, and complex-system behavior.
  • Join a high-agency culture: Work with a remote-first team that values expertise, intellectual honesty, experimentation, and ownership.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary, benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth and development.

Pay Rate:

The annual base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $215,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Edge Case considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays.

Washington state applicants only: Full-time employees accrue at least 13 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; and receive at least 96 hours for holidays.

Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads Specialist) – Remote

Meta Ads | Facebook & Instagram Advertising | Performance Marketing | Creative Strategy

Location: Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads Specialist) to take full ownership of paid social advertising across multiple client and internal accounts.

This is far more than a campaign management role. You’ll own the entire performance lifecycle—from campaign strategy and creative direction to optimization, scaling, and performance reporting. Working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment, you’ll leverage data, creative testing, and audience insights to drive measurable business growth.

If you’ve successfully managed significant advertising budgets, consistently improved campaign performance, and understand how creative, offers, and analytics work together to generate results, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Meta Ads Strategy & Campaign Management

  • Build, launch, manage, and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
  • Own campaign performance from planning through scaling.
  • Manage multiple client and internal ad accounts simultaneously.
  • Oversee monthly advertising budgets ranging from $10K–$250K+.
  • Scale profitable campaigns while maintaining efficiency and profitability.

Creative Strategy & Performance Marketing

  • Develop high-converting campaign concepts, hooks, and messaging.
  • Write compelling ad copy focused on improving:
    • CTR
    • CPL
    • CPA
    • ROAS
  • Create detailed creative briefs for designers, editors, and content creators.
  • Lead creative strategy across:
    • Static image ads
    • UGC-style videos
    • Video scripts
    • AI-assisted creative workflows
  • Continuously test new creative angles and messaging.

Campaign Optimization & Analytics

  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Analyze:
    • CTR
    • CPC
    • CPL
    • CPA
    • ROAS
    • Frequency
    • Conversion Rates
  • Optimize audiences, creatives, offers, placements, and landing pages.
  • Identify winning campaigns and scale them strategically.
  • Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns using data-driven insights.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with creative teams to produce high-performing advertising assets.
  • Collaborate with leadership on growth initiatives and campaign priorities.
  • Align paid advertising with broader marketing and revenue objectives.
  • Stay current with Meta platform updates and advertising best practices.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Facebook and Instagram advertising.
  • Proven experience managing at least $10,000/month in Meta ad spend.
  • Experience managing 5 or more advertising accounts simultaneously.

Core Skills

  • Strong expertise with:
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • Facebook Business Suite
    • Meta Pixel
    • Conversion Tracking
    • Attribution Modeling
    • Funnel Optimization
  • Excellent analytical and performance optimization skills.
  • Strong direct-response copywriting and messaging abilities.
  • Ability to identify and scale winning creatives.
  • Deep understanding of performance marketing principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Reliable remote work environment with high-speed internet.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing $100K–$250K+ monthly advertising budgets.
  • Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing strategy.
  • Experience producing or managing UGC advertising campaigns.
  • Ability to brief creators, editors, and designers effectively.
  • Experience using AI tools such as:
    • ChatGPT
    • AI creative generation tools
    • Creative automation platforms
  • Familiarity with:
    • GoHighLevel (GHL)
    • Close CRM
    • Similar marketing platforms
  • Previous experience within agencies or high-growth marketing teams.

Tools & Platforms

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Facebook Business Suite
  • Meta Pixel
  • ChatGPT & AI Creative Tools
  • GoHighLevel (Preferred)
  • Close CRM (Preferred)
  • Marketing Analytics Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly analytical with a performance-first mindset.
  • Strong creative instincts backed by data.
  • Comfortable managing multiple high-budget campaigns.
  • Excellent communicator who collaborates effectively across teams.
  • Ownership-driven with strong accountability.
  • Continuously tests, learns, and improves campaign performance.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign dashboards and key performance metrics.
  • Analyze winning and underperforming creatives.
  • Launch and optimize Meta advertising campaigns.
  • Write ad copy and develop new creative testing ideas.
  • Prepare creative briefs for designers and video editors.
  • Monitor CPL, CPA, CTR, ROAS, and conversion performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on offers, funnels, and campaign strategy.
  • Test new audiences, creatives, hooks, and messaging.
  • Scale winning campaigns while optimizing underperforming ones.

In short: You own paid social growth by combining creative strategy, rapid experimentation, and data-driven optimization to deliver measurable business results.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
  • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
  • Conversion Rate (CVR)
  • Campaign scaling efficiency
  • Revenue and pipeline contribution
  • Creative testing velocity and continuous performance improvements

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over paid social strategy and execution.
  • Opportunity to manage significant advertising budgets.
  • Work in a fast-paced, performance-focused environment.
  • Strong collaboration with creative and leadership teams.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Clear career progression into:
    • Lead Media Buyer
    • Performance Marketing Manager
    • Growth Marketing Lead
    • Director of Paid Media

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Final Client Interview
  4. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about performance marketing, thrive on scaling Meta advertising campaigns, and enjoy using creative strategy and data to drive measurable business growth, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to a high-performing marketing team.

The Tier 2 Support Team serves as the escalation point for customer support interactions that require deeper technical troubleshooting beyond initial intake. This team is responsible for accurate triage, in-depth troubleshooting, and clean resolution or further escalation when necessary.

Tier 2 agents are the voice of tech support for one of our clients. They ensure customers feel heard, supported, and confident throughout their interaction while maintaining strong ticket hygiene, priority accuracy, and documentation standards.

This role operates at the escalation and resolution level, ensuring tickets move efficiently through the system without bottlenecks.

PRIMARY FUNCTION

  • Answer SMS, emails, and tickets promptly
  • Gather complete and accurate information during intake
  • Triage and prioritize based on urgency and business impact
  • Resolve routine technical requests within Tier 1 scope
  • Escalate internally with full documentation when required
  • Maintain queue hygiene and SLA alignment
  • Eventually Answer inbound calls
Tier 2 agents do not escalate directly to customer executive contacts. Escalations remain internal to Menu or Networking teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Call & Ticket Intake

  • Serve as the first line of support for all inbound channels
  • Capture critical details including impacted system, symptoms, steps taken, and urgency
  • Document thoroughly in the ticketing system
  • Set clear expectations with customers regarding next steps

First-Level Troubleshooting & Execution

Resolve routine issues using knowledge base documentation and predefined workflows, including:
  • Password resets
  • 86 / un-86 requests
  • Online ordering pauses
  • Hours of operation updates
  • Basic login and user access issues
Attempt first-contact resolution whenever possible while maintaining quality and accuracy.

Ticket Hygiene & Queue Management

  • Open and fully review tickets before taking action
  • Validate subject line, problem statement, type, category, platform, and priority
  • Maintain SLA targets
  • SMS First Response: Under 5 minutes
  • Email First Response: Under 30 minutes
  • Keep personal queue organized and current
  • Ensure escalations include full troubleshooting context

Customer Communication

  • Communicate clearly, calmly, and professionally
  • Provide realistic timelines when escalation is required
  • Avoid over-promising resolution
  • Ensure customers feel informed and supported throughout the interaction

Knowledge Base & Process Contribution

  • Utilize internal documentation consistently
  • Flag outdated or missing documentation
  • Escalate recurring issue trends to Shift Leads

Collaboration & Escalation

  • Notify Shift Leads of high-impact or trending issues
  • Avoid unnecessary Slack alerts for non-urgent issues
  • Support team queue health during high-volume periods

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • First response times consistently within SLA
  • Clean, complete tickets with minimal rework
  • Accurate prioritization and categorization
  • High first-contact resolution for routine issues
  • Customers feel confident after initial interaction
  • Escalations are clear and require no additional clarification

  • Zendesk experience

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for highly curious, bold and critical thinker who would thrive in an environment centred on producing provocative, forward-looking insights to help CFOs reshape their finance functions and enterprises for 2030 and beyond. If you’ve spent a good part of your career in strategic finance or special projects working with the CFO, get restless when the pace of change isn’t tracking with external dynamics, and are energized by challenging conventional wisdom and current ways of working, then this Gartner analyst role could be for you.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

  • 12+ years’ experience working in a finance function, ideally with 2+ years of recent AI experience.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

jobs.description:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Sourcer to help identify and engage exceptional talent across Tailscale as we continue to scale globally.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with deep sourcing expertise, technical fluency, and strong talent market knowledge. You’ll partner with Talent Acquisition Partners, hiring managers, and TA leadership to develop and execute sourcing strategies across Engineering, Product, Design, GTM, G&A, executive, confidential, and other business-critical searches.

We’re looking for someone who can quickly understand complex and ambiguous hiring needs, translate them into sophisticated search strategies, and find talent others may overlook. Beyond individual searches, you’ll help strengthen sourcing across Talent Acquisition through market intelligence, talent mapping, inclusive sourcing, knowledge sharing, and experimentation with new approaches.

Key Responsibilities

Build & Execute Sourcing Strategies

  • Lead sourcing strategies for complex, high-priority, and difficult-to-fill searches across technical, GTM, G&A, leadership, and other specialized functions.
  • Translate business needs, role requirements, and talent market dynamics into targeted search strategies and actionable sourcing plans.
  • Identify and engage exceptional passive talent through advanced research, diverse sourcing channels, networks, communities, and creative approaches.
  • Independently manage multiple searches and adjust strategies based on pipeline performance, candidate feedback, market conditions, and evolving priorities.

Source Highly Technical & Specialized Talent

  • Develop deep knowledge of Tailscale’s product, technology, business, and technical culture to identify candidates who can thrive here.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition Partners and hiring teams to translate highly technical or nuanced profiles into effective talent searches.
  • Research adjacent companies, technologies, open-source ecosystems, communities, and talent pools to uncover candidates beyond traditional sources.
  • Build credibility with technical and specialized talent by understanding their backgrounds, motivations, and the work they care about.

Use Data & Market Intelligence

  • Bring expertise and comfort with sourcing data and market insights to assess pipeline health, identify hiring risks, and improve sourcing strategies.
  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to provide actionable insights on talent availability, competitive landscapes, geographies, and hiring challenges.
  • Surface market constraints and opportunities early and recommend adjustments to profiles, locations, or sourcing approaches.
  • Translate market intelligence into actionable recommendations for Talent Acquisition Partners, leadership, and hiring teams.

Champion Inclusive Sourcing

  • Build inclusive sourcing strategies that identify exceptional talent across a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, communities, and career paths.
  • Challenge unnecessarily narrow search criteria and recommend approaches that broaden qualified talent pools.
  • Identify new communities, networks, and sourcing channels that expand access to talent.
  • Use research and pipeline data to identify opportunities to improve sourcing approaches and candidate representation.

Engage & Cultivate Exceptional Talent

  • Create compelling, personalized outreach for highly sought-after candidates and complex talent markets.
  • Build authentic relationships with passive talent and cultivate pipelines that support current and future hiring needs.
  • Assess candidate interest, motivation, experience, and alignment before transitioning candidates into the broader recruiting process.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition Partners to ensure seamless handoffs and an exceptional candidate experience.

Elevate Sourcing Across Talent Acquisition

  • Collaborate across Talent Acquisition on complex searches, sourcing strategy, candidate calibration, and evolving hiring priorities.
  • Facilitate sourcing jams and share advanced sourcing techniques, market intelligence, search strategies, and talent insights across the team.
  • Build reusable talent maps, research resources, and sourcing frameworks for recurring or strategic hiring needs.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition Operations and leadership to improve sourcing tools, workflows, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled practices.

What We Are Looking For

  • 6+ years of talent sourcing and/or recruiting experience, with significant experience sourcing highly competitive talent in high-growth or highly technical environments.
  • Demonstrated success sourcing across multiple functions, with deep experience identifying highly technical Engineering and Product talent and supporting complex, leadership, or specialized searches.
  • Advanced expertise in sourcing techniques, talent research, market mapping, competitive intelligence, and building pipelines beyond traditional candidate pools.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex or ambiguous roles and independently translate them into sophisticated sourcing strategies.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to use sourcing data and market intelligence to influence search strategies and engage highly sought-after talent.
  • Proven ability to partner with Talent Acquisition Partners, hiring managers, and senior leaders, using strong judgment to challenge assumptions and recommend changes when appropriate.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities while collaborating across Talent Acquisition and elevating sourcing practices through knowledge sharing, tools, AI, and emerging approaches.

Nice to Have

  • Deep experience sourcing infrastructure, networking, security, developer tools, distributed systems, cloud, or similarly technical engineering talent.
  • Experience finding technical talent through open-source ecosystems, GitHub, technical communities, research, and other channels beyond traditional recruiting platforms.
  • Experience supporting executive or confidential searches and sourcing globally across North America, EMEA, and/or APAC.
  • Experience building talent maps or market intelligence that materially influenced hiring strategy or helped leaders broaden how they define exceptional talent.
  • Experience facilitating sourcing jams, sharing advanced sourcing practices, or otherwise raising sourcing capability across a Talent Acquisition team.
  • A reputation for finding exceptional people others struggle to find—and understanding how to engage them effectively.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

$134,000—$174,200 CAD

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL.   • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.

jobs.description:
About the Role

TurFresh is looking for a hands-on Growth & Marketing Operations Manager to improve marketing performance across multiple markets.

This role combines strategy, analytics, execution oversight and team coordination. You will connect paid media, SEO, local search, CRM, marketing automation, websites, lead handling, agencies and internal specialists into one accountable system.

You will work closely with John and the President/General Manager, who will provide strategic guidance and feedback. You will be expected to turn that direction into clear plans, disciplined execution and measurable results.

You should be analytical, commercially minded, organized, technically capable and comfortable moving between strategy and execution.

You should naturally ask:

What happened? Why did it happen? Was the work executed correctly? What should we do next?

What You Will Own

    • Marketing performance by market and channel

    • Weekly KPI reporting and executive communication

    • Lead volume, qualified leads, CPL, CAC, conversion and ROI

    • Paid-media agency performance

    • SEO, local SEO and Google Business Profile performance

    • Lead attribution, CRM and marketing automation

    • Website and landing-page conversion

    • Marketing priorities, projects and vendor deliverables

    • Coordination between Marketing, Sales and Operations

    • Marketing processes, SOPs and quality control

What You Will Do

    Performance & Analytics

    Track performance across paid search, organic search, local search, email/SMS, referrals and other channels.

    Connect marketing activity to:

    Lead → Contact → Quote → Sale → Revenue

    Investigate changes in lead volume, lead quality, cost, conversion, revenue and market performance. Determine whether problems come from strategy, execution, tracking, lead routing, follow-up, agencies or market conditions.

    Translate data into clear recommendations, owners, action steps and success criteria.

Growth Management

    Identify opportunities to increase profitable customer acquisition.

    Evaluate:

    • Market and channel performance

    • Budget allocation

    • Search and keyword opportunities

    • Landing pages

    • Local search

    • Lead reactivation

    • CRM and follow-up

    • New tests and growth initiatives

    Work with John and the President/General Manager to prioritize opportunities and execute them effectively.

Hands-On Marketing Direction

    Provide practical direction to agencies, vendors and internal specialists.

    You should be able to review and improve:

    • Paid-search structure, targeting, bids, budgets and ad copy

    • Keywords and negative keywords

    • Landing pages and conversion paths

    • SEO and local-search execution

    • Google Business Profiles

    • CRM workflows and lead routing

    • Tracking and attribution

    • Website forms and calls

    • Marketing SOPs and quality-control processes

    You do not need to perform every task daily, but you must understand the work well enough to direct it, evaluate it, teach it and step in when necessary.

Agency & Vendor Management

    Set clear expectations for each agency or specialist, including:

    • Objective

    • Strategy

    • Required work

    • KPI and target

    • Deliverable

    • Deadline

    • Result

    • Corrective action

    Challenge vague explanations and distinguish between poor strategy, weak execution, tracking issues, lead-quality problems and sales follow-up problems.

Marketing Operations

    Create structure around the marketing department.

    Maintain:

    • Priorities and project ownership

    • Due dates and reporting

    • KPI dashboards

    • Campaign calendars

    • Testing backlogs

    • Vendor deliverables

    • SOPs and training materials

    • Quality-control checklists

    • Open issues and follow-up items

    Eliminate, automate, delegate or simplify low-value work.

Sales & Marketing Alignment

    Work with Sales to understand what happens after a lead is generated.

    Use downstream results to evaluate targeting, messaging, qualification, routing, response time, follow-up and sales execution.

    Marketing success is not simply generating inquiries. The goal is generating qualified opportunities that become profitable customers.

Team Coordination

    Work with specialists in:

    • Paid media

    • SEO and local SEO

    • Google Business Profiles

    • Content

    • Email and SMS

    • Creative

    • Website

    • Marketing automation

    • Analytics and reporting

    You are not expected to own every specialty, but you must be able to evaluate the work, set direction, identify problems, coach others and hold people accountable.

Executive Partnership

    Our owner and the President/General Manager are both marketers and will remain actively involved.

    They will provide strategic guidance, feedback and context on priorities, positioning, messaging and customer experience.

    You will be expected to present recommendations, accept feedback, revise plans when appropriate and own the day-to-day marketing operating system.

What Success Looks Like

    Within your first 90 days, you will have:

    • Established a reliable weekly marketing scorecard

    • Created clear ownership across marketing functions

    • Improved visibility into performance by market and channel

    • Evaluated agency, vendor and execution quality

    • Improved lead attribution and CAC reporting

    • Connected marketing results to sales outcomes

    • Identified priority growth opportunities

    • Documented key SOPs and standards

    • Created a testing and optimization roadmap

    • Established an effective working rhythm with leadership

    Over time, success means:

    • More qualified leads

    • Lower acquisition costs

    • Better marketing efficiency

    • Stronger attribution

    • Better agency accountability

    • More consistent execution

    • Faster problem resolution

    • Stronger internal capability

    • More predictable revenue growth

Ideal Background

    We are looking for someone with approximately 5–8+ years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, marketing operations, demand generation or digital marketing.

    Strong candidates will have hands-on experience with several of the following:

    • Google Ads / PPC

    • SEO and local SEO

    • Google Business Profiles

    • GA4 and Google Search Console

    • CRM and marketing automation

    • Lead routing and call tracking

    • Attribution and reporting

    • Conversion-rate optimization

    • Landing pages and websites

    • Agency management

    • Multi-market or local service businesses

    • Executive KPI reporting

    • SOP development

    • Team training or coaching

    Experience personally diagnosing and correcting marketing problems is especially valuable.

The Person We Are Looking For

    You are:

Job Title: Platform Engineer - Commercial Services Tools

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is the cloud software leader for the life sciences industry, building the platform that helps the world’s largest pharma and biotech companies bring treatments to patients faster. The Commercial Tools team is building the next generation of services tools that our global services teams rely on every day, and we're building them best-in-class on a genuinely modern stack.
As a Services Platform Engineer you'll ship real, cutting-edge AI features to production fast — working shoulder-to-shoulder with a small, highly collaborative team that moves quickly and hands you real ownership from day one. You'll go deep across backend, frontend, cloud and applied AI, learn from engineers who know the craft, and build a career at the frontier of AI engineering — in an industry where the software you write helps get treatments to patients faster.

What You'll Do

    • Build best-in-class AI features end to end — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows and LLM apps on AWS Bedrock and Bedrock Knowledge Bases, like our CRM Helper on ECS Fargate — and ship them to production fast
    • Design and ship async Python services (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 async, asyncpg on Postgres 17) that stream live job progress to users over WebSocket/SSE
    • Build and own features in our React/TypeScript portal that global services teams rely on every single day
    • Take real ownership from day one — features are yours from design through deploy, with mentorship from engineers who know the craft
    • Move fast and keep it solid: own the tests, CI and observability that let a small team ship confidently every day
    • Range across the whole stack — backend, frontend, cloud (AWS) and applied AI — and go as deep as your curiosity takes you
    • Learn the Veeva Vault and CRM platform APIs that power the life-sciences tools you're building

Requirements

    • 2+ years building and shipping real production software — you've put your work in front of real users
    • Strong Python with hands-on experience building async REST APIs, FastAPI ideal (SQLAlchemy 2 async / asyncpg / Postgres a plus)
    • You've built at least one real agent or RAG application and understand embeddings, vector search, chunking, and prompting in practice
    • Comfortable across the stack — happy to jump into a React/TypeScript frontend as well as backend services
    • Working knowledge of SQL / PostgreSQL and confident with Git-based team workflows
    • Foundational AWS — you've deployed something and understand IAM roles and containers (Docker)
    • Genuine curiosity for AI and hunger to learn new tech fast — you want to build a career at the frontier of AI engineering
    • Strong written and verbal English, and you thrive in a fast-moving, fully remote team

Nice to Have

    • Exposure to AWS Bedrock and agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph
    • Async Python and WebSocket/SSE streaming
    • Frontend experience with React, TypeScript, Vite and MUI
    • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines
    • Observability tooling such as CloudWatch, Grafana, or Prometheus

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $90,000 - $150,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

We are looking for a Manager, Customer Support to focus on our Security and Alarm, Bold Group. Bold Group, a division of EverCommerce, serves the electronic security industry with the most comprehensive array of alarm monitoring and integrated business management software solutions tailored to achieve optimal business performance. Bold Group’s product portfolio features the renowned alarm monitoring systems Manitou and Stages™. These leading alarm monitoring systems are complemented by the industry’s top accounting and business management systems: the SedonaOffice suite, AlarmBiller and Managely.

The Manager, Customer Support is a hands-on leadership role responsible for delivering exceptional customer support experiences, driving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and issue resolution while directly leading a team of Customer Support Representatives or Support Specialists. This is a player-coach position that balances people leadership with direct involvement in managing complex customer issues, escalations, and high-impact support cases. The Manager serves as both an experienced Support leader and an individual contributor, providing guidance on critical customer situations while coaching the team to deliver consistent, high-quality support experiences. This role develops and executes the Customer Support strategy, partners closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and Operations, and drives scalable support processes that improve service quality, increase team efficiency, and ensure customers receive timely, effective resolutions that build trust and long-term customer loyalty.

Responsibilities:

Customer Support Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Customer Support Representatives and Support Specialists through regular coaching, performance management, career development, and technical skill-building.
  • Establish clear goals, service metrics, and accountability for team performance.
  • Develop and execute the Customer Support strategy to deliver exceptional customer experiences, operational excellence, and efficient issue resolution.
  • Foster a high-performance, customer-centric culture focused on service quality, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing development of Customer Support talent.

Player-Coach Responsibilities

  • Personally manage complex customer escalations and high-impact support cases, serving as the primary point of leadership for critical customer issues.
  • Partner directly with customers and internal stakeholders to drive timely resolution of complex technical and operational challenges.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and Operations to coordinate cross-functional resolution efforts and ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for the support organization, providing guidance on critical cases, customer communications, and executive escalations.
  • Lead post-incident reviews and identify opportunities to improve support processes, knowledge, and customer outcomes.

Customer Experience & Support Delivery

  • Drive exceptional customer experiences by ensuring timely, accurate, and effective resolution of customer issues.
  • Monitor support trends, case volume, backlog health, SLA performance, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure consistent execution of support processes through standardized workflows, knowledge management, and best practices.
  • Promote proactive customer communication throughout the support lifecycle, ensuring customers remain informed and confident during issue resolution.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and partner with Product and Engineering to reduce support demand through product enhancements and defect resolution.
  • Manage 24x7 on call staff and escalations

Operational Excellence

  • Design, document, refine, and scale Customer Support processes, workflows, knowledge articles, and operational best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support activities and improve team productivity through technology, AI, and workflow optimization.
  • Ensure customer interactions, case updates, and resolution details are consistently documented within CRM and support systems.
  • Define and maintain KPIs and dashboards that provide visibility into support performance, SLA compliance, customer satisfaction, backlog health, case quality, and team productivity.
  • Champion operational consistency while improving efficiency, service quality, and the overall customer experience.
  • Lead Customer Support initiatives that improve scalability, operational maturity, and service excellence.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to communicate customer issues, prioritize defects, and provide customer impact that informs product roadmap decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success and Professional Services to ensure seamless customer transitions, issue ownership, and ongoing customer satisfaction.
  • Work with Revenue Operations, Operations, and Sales Leadership to improve customer experience, reduce friction, and support customer retention through effective issue resolution.

Voice of the Customer

  • Serve as the voice of the customer by identifying trends in support cases, product issues, and customer feedback.
  • Develop structured processes for collecting, analyzing, and communicating customer insights across the organization.
  • Translate customer feedback and support analytics into recommendations that improve product quality, customer experience, self-service resources, and operational effectiveness.

Success Measures

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • First Response Time (FRT)
  • Average Resolution Time (ART) / Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR)
  • Service Level Agreement (SLA) attainment
  • Backlog health and case aging
  • Support quality assurance (QA) scores
  • Escalation volume and resolution effectiveness
  • First Contact Resolution (FCR), where applicable
  • Knowledge base utilization and self-service effectiveness
  • Customer effort and support experience metrics (where applicable)
  • Team performance, engagement, and employee development
  • Operational efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)

Skills and Experience Needed for Success in This Role

Required

  • 2–5+ years of Customer Support, Technical Support, Service Delivery, or related SaaS experience.
  • 1–4+ years of people management experience leading Customer Support or Technical Support teams.
  • Experience managing complex customer escalations and delivering exceptional support experiences in an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated success improving customer satisfaction, support quality, SLA performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Strong executive communication and customer-facing skills, with the ability to effectively manage high-impact customer situations and executive escalations.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Operations to resolve customer issues and improve the customer experience.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with experience using support metrics and operational KPIs to drive continuous improvement.
  • Experience developing and coaching high-performing support teams through performance management, quality assurance, and career development.

Preferred

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, DevOps, QA, software testing, or developer tooling.
  • Experience with CRM, help desk, and customer support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira Service Management, Freshdesk, or similar).
  • Experience managing service level agreements (SLAs), incident management, escalation processes, and support operations.
  • Experience with knowledge management, support process optimization, workflow automation, and AI-assisted support tools.
  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent experience with IT service management principles is a plus.

Where: Remote, US[Travel may be required up to 10% of the time].
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid

jobs.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Principal AI Developer Experience Architect, you will serve as the technical authority for the AI engineering layer at SentinelOne, designing how enterprise-grade AI coding assistants and LLM platforms integrate into our engineering workflows. You will own the strategy and architecture that ensures AI-generated code is trustworthy, performant, and reliable by default for an 800+ developer organization. Your work will ensure our AI tooling investment is secure, governed, and measurably impactful across context management, prompt design, and AI-driven code review.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

Architect the AI Engineering Layer

  • Define the end‑to‑end architecture for AI-augmented development at SentinelOne, centered on enterprise-grade AI coding assistants and LLM platforms integrated with our IDEs, CI/CD pipelines, and internal platforms.
  • Design how large-context LLMs consume our codebase and documentation context so that AI assistance scales safely across hundreds of repos.
  • Establish reusable patterns for agentic workflows with clear rollback and validation strategies.

Own AI Guardrails, Skills, and Standards

  • Define and maintain SentinelOne AI Coding Standards and a global skills & requirements framework that all AI coding tools (our chosen AI coding assistants, PR bots, agents) must enforce, including language, framework, security, performance, and reliability patterns.
  • Translate these standards into prompt templates, tool configurations, and policy‑as‑code so they are enforced automatically rather than via documentation alone.
  • Partner with InfoSec, Data Governance, and Legal to ensure all AI tooling adheres to SentinelOne’s AI Policies, data residency, and FedRAMP compliance requirements.

Implement AI-Driven Code Review and Safety as Code

  • Lead the integration of AI-powered code review tools that use AST analysis and static/dynamic checks to enforce style, security, performance, and reliability standards before human review.
  • Integrate AI review signals with our SRE observability stack (logs, metrics, traces) to correlate code changes with incidents and anomalies, closing the loop from PR to production behavior.
  • Encode “safety as code” by integrating test coverage, performance scans, and progressive delivery patterns (canaries, blue/green) into AI‑authored change flows.

Lead Vendor Evaluation and Integration

  • Serve as the principal technical owner for AI developer tooling evaluations using structured evaluation criteria and data-driven analysis.
  • Work closely with the DevEx leadership and TPM to design and run POCs, define technical success criteria, and produce executive‑ready recommendations.
  • Ensure all vendors meet SentinelOne’s security, privacy, and data governance standards.

Drive Developer Adoption and Experience

  • Act as the technical face of AI DevEx to engineering: publish guidance, patterns, and internal frameworks that make AI tooling a seamless part of everyday work rather than a side experiment.
  • Partner with the AI Champions Network and Learning & Development to define curricula, hands-on labs, and “day‑in‑the‑life” workflows that level up prompt engineering and AI‑assisted development skills across developer organizations.
  • Collaborate across the SentinelOne developer community to translate adoption and productivity signals into DORA metrics and ROI narratives that are credible to Engineering Leadership, Finance, and the CFO.

Partner on Reliability, Metrics, and Governance

  • Work with SRE and Reliability Engineering to ensure AI‑accelerated delivery improves MTTR, CFR, and SLO performance.
  • Participate in the DevEx governance model to prioritize initiatives, manage risk, and align AI DevEx roadmaps with company objectives.
  • Own the engineering intelligence dashboards and leadership reports to surface the impact of AI tooling on developer productivity metrics.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

Experience

  • 10+ years in software engineering, platform/dev tools, or infrastructure engineering, including significant experience operating at Staff/Principal level in a 300+ engineer product organization.
  • 3+ years designing and shipping LLM‑powered developer tools or workflows in production environments.
  • Proven track record of architecting developer platforms or large‑scale internal tooling used by hundreds of engineers.

Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of LLM context window design, retrieval strategies, prompt engineering at scale, and how they interact with large polyglot codebases.
  • Hands-on experience integrating at least one enterprise AI coding assistant into IDEs and Git hosting platforms.
  • Strong background in AST-based code analysis, static/dynamic analysis, and policy-as-code for automated PR review.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD systems and progressive delivery and how to embed AI in those pipelines.
  • Strong grounding in security and compliance for SaaS and AI/ML systems

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Experience acting as a cross‑org technical leader: aligning Staff/Principal engineers, EMs, and PMs around a shared architecture and standard.
  • Comfortable presenting technical tradeoffs and ROI to senior leadership, and defending architecture choices with data.
  • Proven ability to mentor and partner with the entire Product and Technology organization to deliver complex multi‑quarter programs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear design docs, evaluation criteria, and developer‑facing guidance that drive alignment at scale.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

With two decades of experience guiding clients to realize the full potential of the ServiceNow AI Platform, NewRocket is one of the largest pure-play ServiceNow partners. We are uniquely focused on enabling enterprises to adopt AI they trust—AI that delivers lasting business value.

NewRocket is proud to be an Anthropic partner/vendor. Through this relationship, we are expanding our ability to help enterprise clients responsibly design, deploy, and scale AI solutions powered by Claude and other leading AI technologies. Our AI Foundry teams apply Anthropic-aligned practices across prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, tool use, structured outputs, model evaluation, security, governance, and human-in-the-loop controls.

We #GoBeyondWorkflows to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.

Come join our Crew!

Role Overview

NewRocket is seeking an experienced AI Platform Engineer to build, operate, and continuously improve the technical foundations that enable secure, reliable, scalable enterprise AI solutions.

This role combines cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps/LLMOps, data-platform integration, and applied AI engineering. The AI Platform Engineer will work closely with AI Architects, Forward Deployed AI Engineers, data engineers, ServiceNow teams, product engineering, and customer stakeholders to create reusable platforms, deployment patterns, controls, and operational capabilities for NewRocket’s Anthropic and enterprise AI business.

You will help establish the infrastructure and engineering practices required to move AI solutions from prototype to governed production use. This includes enabling Claude and other LLM-powered applications; supporting RAG and agentic workflows; integrating enterprise data and tools; implementing observability and evaluation; and maintaining strong security, privacy, and governance controls.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who is comfortable working across cloud infrastructure, APIs, CI/CD, data systems, containers, AI application frameworks, and enterprise security requirements. You are equally motivated by building reusable internal capabilities and solving practical customer-delivery challenges.

Key Responsibilities

AI Platform Architecture & Engineering

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable platform capabilities that support enterprise AI, machine learning, LLM, RAG, and agentic AI applications.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, infrastructure patterns, deployment templates, integration components, and engineering standards for NewRocket’s AI Foundry.
  • Build platform capabilities that enable AI applications to securely connect to enterprise data, APIs, workflow systems, and authorized tools.
  • Partner with AI Architects and Forward Deployed AI Engineers to translate client needs into reliable, supportable technical platform designs.
  • Support the technical evolution of NewRocket’s AI intellectual property, including the NewRocket Intelligence Platform, Data Intelligence Platform, Value Realization Dashboard, Agent Packs, and reusable AI accelerators.
  • Evaluate and recommend cloud, data, AI, observability, orchestration, and security technologies that improve delivery speed, quality, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Anthropic, Claude & LLM Platform Enablement

  • Build and maintain secure, reusable integrations with the Anthropic API, Claude models, and other approved AI services.
  • Enable LLM-powered applications through standardized patterns for authentication, model access, prompt and context management, structured outputs, tool use, logging, error handling, and rate-limit management.
  • Support Claude-based enterprise use cases involving document analysis, knowledge assistance, workflow automation, agentic task execution, summarization, classification, and decision support.
  • Develop technical patterns for long-context workflows, document processing, RAG, structured data extraction, and model-driven automation.
  • Support secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) and comparable tool-integration patterns that allow AI applications to access approved enterprise systems and data safely.
  • Stay current on Anthropic platform capabilities, product releases, security guidance, technical enablement, and responsible AI practices.
  • Complete relevant Anthropic partner training and enablement as available and help translate learning into reusable NewRocket engineering standards.

LLMOps, MLOps & AI Operations

  • Establish and operate CI/CD pipelines for AI applications, model configurations, prompts, evaluation assets, infrastructure, and integration services.
  • Implement versioning, testing, release-management, rollback, and change-control practices for AI solutions.
  • Build and maintain LLMOps and MLOps capabilities, including model/prompt configuration management, evaluation pipelines, deployment automation, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop automated evaluation and regression-testing frameworks to measure AI quality before and after releases.
  • Support production operations for AI services, including incident response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, capacity planning, and service-level monitoring.
  • Define and monitor operational metrics such as availability, latency, throughput, token consumption, model cost, tool-call success rates, task-completion rates, and error rates.
  • Improve platform reliability, performance, resilience, and cost efficiency through automation, tuning, and operational improvements.

Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps & Security

  • Design and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or client-approved environments.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Pulumi, or comparable technologies.
  • Implement containerized application and AI-service deployments using Docker, Kubernetes, serverless services, and cloud-native application patterns.
  • Develop secure CI/CD workflows using Git-based source control, automated testing, artifact management, secrets management, and policy controls.
  • Implement identity, access, and authentication patterns, including role-based access control, least-privilege access, API security, service accounts, and credential rotation.
  • Partner with security, compliance, and client teams to ensure AI platforms align with enterprise security, privacy, regulatory, and data-residency requirements.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, auditing, vulnerability management, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity practices for production AI services.

Data Platform & RAG Enablement

  • Build and support secure data-ingestion, transformation, indexing, and retrieval pipelines for enterprise AI applications.
  • Design platform patterns for RAG, including document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search, retrieval, reranking, and source attribution.
  • Integrate AI applications with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources, including databases, data warehouses, document repositories, knowledge bases, ServiceNow, and third-party SaaS platforms.
  • Work with data engineers to establish data-quality, lineage, cataloging, permissions, retention, and governance practices that support trustworthy AI.
  • Enable appropriate data-access controls so AI solutions retrieve and process only data the requesting user or service is authorized to access.
  • Support data platforms and technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, vector databases, and cloud storage services, as appropriate.

Responsible AI, Governance & Observability

  • Implement technical controls that support responsible, secure, and governable AI deployments.
  • Build safeguards for sensitive-data handling, data masking, content filtering, prompt injection, unsafe tool use, unauthorized access, and unintended agent behavior.
  • Enable grounding, output validation, source attribution, confidence thresholds, fallback behavior, approval gates, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Implement AI observability and tracing across prompts, model calls, retrieval pipelines, tool execution, workflow outcomes, latency, errors, costs, and user feedback.
  • Partner with AI Architects and governance stakeholders to document platform standards, risk controls, operating procedures, and solution limitations.
  • Support auditability and compliance requirements through appropriate logging, retention, access reviews, and operational documentation.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Implement CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and LLMOps practices that improve deployment speed, quality, and operational maturity.

  • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, Bash, or similar programming and scripting languages.
  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, integrating enterprise applications, and implementing authentication and authorization patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-powered applications, generative AI services, AI/ML platforms, RAG systems, AI workflow automation, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity with LLM application concepts, including prompt and context engineering, token management, embeddings, vector search, RAG, structured outputs, tool use/function calling, evaluations, and model monitoring.
  • Experience with observability tools and practices, including logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and incident management.

  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative, customer-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualifications

As the Product Manager UX Orchestration, you own the no-code configuration layer of the Actirise solution: the tools that let publishers activate ad formats, configure the video player, and set up the CMP/Paywall experience — without a single line of code. You are the guardian of a consistent, controlled self-serve experience across every surface: back-office, client-facing UI, native platform, and WordPress plugin alike.

Your mission: make configuration effortless for publishers while keeping Actirise in control of what's truly self-serve versus internally managed — turning orchestration into a growth lever, not an operational bottleneck.

Your key responsibilities:

1. No-Code Configuration Strategy

  • Define which configuration flows are self-serve vs. internally-managed, and design the framework that governs that boundary.

  • Own the roadmap for the tagging plan (ad format activation), enabling publishers to activate and manage formats without dev intervention.

2. Player & Video Catalog Configuration

  • Own the player template configuration experience: enable publishers to customize player behavior and appearance without engineering support.

3. CMP / Paywall Template Configuration

  • Own the CMP/Paywall template configuration layer to deliver an easy configuration experience that respects both constraints.

  • Ensure publishers can configure consent/paywall templates consistently, regardless of the surface they use.

4. Cross-Surface Consistency

  • Guarantee that the configuration experience is coherent whether accessed via back-office, client-facing platform, or the WordPress plugin.

  • Ensure design system application to keep configuration UI patterns consistent across surfaces.

  • Define and maintain clean data contracts and ACLs for every configuration action.

5. Agentic Exposure

  • Apply an agentic-first principle to every configuration capability: whatever a publisher or an internal user can do through the UI must also be executable by an AI agent not just clickable in a screen.

  • Continuously audit existing configuration flows to close the human/agent parity gap ("can an agent already do what a human can do here?") and prioritize closing the biggest gaps.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sparteo Account squad to ensure configuration is part of a smooth time-to-activation journey.

  • Coordinate with PM Engagement on shared UI/UX and compliance boundaries.

  • Partner with Tech/Engineering to ship configuration tools that are reliable, fast, and scalable.

The Profile We're Looking For

  • Systems Thinker: Able to design frameworks (self-serve vs. managed) rather than one-off features — you think in guardrails, permissions, and consistency across surfaces.

  • Cross-Functional Operator: Comfortable working at the intersection of multiple squads where boundaries require coordination, not competition.

  • Agentic Mindset: Naturally designs every capability with a dual interface in mind — human UI and agent-executable action. Understands agent tool-calling patterns and can define clean, well-scoped tool interfaces rather than exposing raw UI logic.

  • AdTech / Video Culture: Familiarity with ad format activation, video players, or CMP/consent tooling is a strong plus.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Location: Remote (United States)

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a marketing analyst internship that sits between the data and the decision. We generate a lot of signal across outbound, inbound, content, and the product itself, and most of it goes unread. Your job is to find the pattern in it, explain what it means in plain language, and then help act on it. The analysis is only half the role: the other half is that someone changes what they do because of what you found.

You will work close to the growth function at an early-stage company, which means the questions are open rather than assigned. Expect to spend time in spreadsheets, to have to define a metric before you can report it, and to write up what you learned so it survives past the week you learned it.

Responsibilities

  • Pull, clean, and analyze data across marketing, outbound, and product usage.
  • Identify patterns and anomalies, and explain what is causing them in plain language.
  • Build and maintain simple reporting that the team actually reads and uses.
  • Define and document metrics so numbers mean the same thing week to week.
  • Turn findings into concrete recommendations, and help implement the ones that get picked up.

Requirements

  • Comfort with spreadsheets and basic data analysis.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot patterns in data.
  • Clear written communication, including explaining an insight simply to a non-analyst.
  • Interest in marketing, growth, analytics, startups, recruiting, or AI products.
  • Organized and comfortable working across several projects at once.
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote startup environment.
